Seven men with very different motives take the job for little pay, train the farmers to fight, and face a showdown far bigger than the money is worth.
writers: Akira Kurosawa, Shinobu Hashimoto, Hideo Oguni (earlier film)

r-13-assassins-2010.plot: In late feudal Japan, a sadistic lord protected by his family ties to the shogun commits atrocities with impunity. A veteran samurai secretly assembles a band of twelve warriors, plus an unexpected thirteenth, to ambush him and his far larger escort.

r-samurai-i-musashi-miyamoto-1954.plot: After the Battle of Sekigahara, wild young Takezo returns home a fugitive and lives like an outlaw. Captured by a wise monk and confronted with his own savagery, he begins the transformation into the swordsman Musashi Miyamoto.

r-crimson-tide-1995.plot: During a Russian political crisis, a US nuclear submarine receives an order to launch its missiles, then a garbled follow-up message. The veteran captain and his new executive officer clash over whether to fire.

setting.place: A US submarine in the Pacific

r-the-court-martial-of-billy-mitchell-19.plot: After publicly blaming military leaders for neglecting air power and causing fatal crashes, General Billy Mitchell is court-martialed for insubordination. He uses the trial to argue his warnings about the future of aerial warfare.

r-breaker-morant-1980.plot: During the Boer War, three Australian officers in a British irregular unit are court-martialed for killing prisoners and a missionary. Their defense lawyer argues they followed unwritten orders, while the trial serves larger political interests.

r-come-back-little-sheba-1952.plot: A recovering alcoholic chiropractor and his lonely, nostalgic wife share a stagnant marriage in a Midwestern town. When they take in a lively young college boarder, old regrets resurface and his sobriety starts to crack.

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Shirley Booth
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Terry Moore

r-how-to-marry-a-millionaire-1953.plot: Three New York models rent a luxurious penthouse to lure rich husbands. Their schemes go comically wrong as each finds that the men they fall for are not quite what they planned.
r-how-to-marry-a-millionaire-1953.source: The Greeks Had a Word for It; Loco

r-summertime-1955.plot: A lonely American secretary fulfills a long-held dream of visiting Venice. There she falls for a charming, married Venetian shopkeeper and must decide whether to embrace a brief romance.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Katharine Hepburn

r-rome-adventure-1962.plot: A young librarian quits her job at a New England school after a dispute over a racy novel and sails to Rome looking for romance. There she falls for an American architecture student, but the reappearance of his former girlfriend complicates her Italian adventure.

r-the-world-of-suzie-wong-1960.plot: An American architect who has quit his job to try painting moves into a cheap hotel in Hong Kong. There he befriends a spirited young bar girl who becomes his model, and their growing romance has to contend with prejudice, pride and her complicated life.

r-in-the-mood-for-love-2000.plot: In 1962 Hong Kong, a journalist and a secretary move into neighboring rooms in a crowded apartment building. When they realize their spouses are having an affair with each other, they form a quiet, restrained bond of their own.

r-the-bachelor-party-1957.plot: A New York bookkeeper with a pregnant wife and money worries reluctantly joins coworkers for a bachelor party. Their night of bars and parties forces him to question his own marriage and choices.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Carolyn Jones

r-frankie-and-johnny-1991.plot: A cook just out of prison takes a job at a New York diner and falls hard for a guarded waitress. She has been hurt before and resists, but his persistence slowly wears down her defenses.
r-frankie-and-johnny-1991.source: Frankie and Johnny in the Clair de Lune

r-operation-petticoat-1959.plot: A by-the-book submarine commander tries to keep his damaged sub in the war, aided by a smooth-talking scrounger officer. Their mission gets complicated when they take aboard a group of stranded Army nurses.

r-catch-22-1970.plot: On a Mediterranean island during World War II, an American bombardier desperately wants to stop flying missions, but his commanders keep raising the required number. He tries to be declared insane, only to discover the absurd rule that asking to be excused proves you are sane.

r-bus-stop-1956.plot: A naive, boisterous young cowboy in town for a rodeo decides a saloon singer is his angel and resolves to marry her, whether she agrees or not. A snowbound bus stop forces both to see each other more clearly.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Don Murray

r-the-fugitive-kind-1960.plot: A drifting guitar player with a troubled past tries to go straight by taking a job in a shop in a small Southern town. He becomes entangled with the shop's lonely, unhappily married owner and a reckless local heiress, as the town's hostility toward outsiders slowly tightens around him.

r-those-magnificent-men-in-their-flying-.plot: In 1910, a British newspaper baron sponsors an air race from London to Paris to prove Britain's superiority in aviation. Pilots from many nations arrive with their fragile, eccentric machines, along with national stereotypes, sabotage, romance and plenty of crashes.

r-the-great-race-1965.plot: In the early 1900s, a dashing, always-victorious daredevil and his villainous, scheming rival enter an automobile race from New York to Paris. A crusading suffragette reporter joins the competition, and slapstick disasters, a pie fight and a royal intrigue follow along the way.

setting.place: New York to Paris, via the Old West, Alaska, Russia and Europe

r-it-s-a-mad-mad-mad-mad-world-1963.plot: A dying crook tells a group of passing motorists about a stash of stolen money buried under a mysterious 'big W'. Every one of them races to claim it, and their greed sets off a frantic, ever-growing chase across Southern California while a patient police captain watches.

r-shenandoah-1965.plot: A widowed Virginia farmer with a large family refuses to take sides in the Civil War, insisting it is not his fight. When his youngest son is captured by Union soldiers, he and his children set out across the war-torn state to bring him home.

r-the-big-country-1958.plot: A retired sea captain from the East arrives in the West to marry a rancher's daughter. Refusing to prove himself by local standards of toughness, he is drawn into a bitter feud between two ranching families over water rights.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Burl Ives

r-hud-1963.plot: On a struggling Texas cattle ranch, the owner's charming but utterly selfish son clashes with his principled old father. His teenage nephew admires him, until an outbreak of disease in the herd and Hud's treatment of the family housekeeper reveal who he really is.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Melvyn Douglas
Actress in a Leading Role — Patricia Neal
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Paul Newman

r-anna-and-the-king-of-siam-1946.plot: A widowed English schoolteacher travels to Bangkok in the 1860s to teach the many children of King Mongkut. Her clashes and growing mutual respect with the proud, curious king shape her years at the Siamese court.
r-anna-and-the-king-of-siam-1946.source: Anna and the King of Siam

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Gale Sondergaard

r-south-pacific-1958.plot: On a South Pacific island during World War II, a Navy nurse from Arkansas falls for a French planter while a young Marine lieutenant loves a Tonkinese girl. Both must confront their own prejudices as a dangerous mission looms.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-prince-of-egypt-1998.plot: Moses, raised as a prince of Egypt alongside the future pharaoh Rameses, discovers he was born a Hebrew slave. After fleeing into exile, he returns at God's command to demand his people's freedom, setting him against the brother he loves.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-exodus-gods-and-kings-2014.plot: Moses, raised as a prince of Egypt alongside the future pharaoh Ramses, learns of his Hebrew origins and is exiled. Called by God, he returns to demand the freedom of the enslaved Hebrews as plagues ravage the land.

r-samson-and-delilah-1949.plot: The Hebrew strongman Samson, blessed with divine strength, falls for a Philistine woman, provoking the rage of her sister Delilah. Delilah seeks revenge by discovering the secret of his strength and betraying him to the Philistine rulers.

r-rope-1948.plot: Two young men strangle a former classmate to prove their intellectual superiority, hide the body in a chest and then host a dinner party around it. Among the guests is their old teacher, whose suspicions grow as the evening unfolds.

r-inherit-the-wind-1960.plot: A small-town Tennessee schoolteacher is tried for teaching evolution. A famous agnostic defense lawyer and a fiery populist prosecutor turn the courtroom into a national battle over religion and free thought.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Spencer Tracy

r-glengarry-glen-ross-1992.plot: Over two rainy days, a group of desperate real-estate salesmen are told that all but the top sellers will be fired. The pressure pushes them toward lies, scheming and a break-in.

setting.place: A real-estate office in a US city

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Al Pacino

r-king-country-1964.plot: During World War I, a young private who walked away from the front after years of fighting is court-martialed for desertion. The officer assigned to defend him starts out contemptuous but comes to sympathize, and fights to save him from a firing squad.

r-all-that-heaven-allows-1955.plot: A well-off New England widow falls for her younger, free-spirited gardener. Her grown children and country-club friends react with snobbish scorn, forcing her to choose between respectability and happiness.

r-the-teahouse-of-the-august-moon-1956.plot: In occupied Okinawa after the war, an earnest U.S. Army captain is ordered to bring democracy to a village. Guided by a crafty local interpreter, he is gently outmaneuvered as the villagers build a teahouse instead of a schoolhouse.
r-the-teahouse-of-the-august-moon-1956.source: The Teahouse of the August Moon

r-king-rat-1965.plot: In a Japanese prisoner-of-war camp in Singapore near the end of World War II, an American corporal thrives through black-market dealing while other prisoners starve. A young British officer becomes his partner and friend, while a rigid provost marshal is determined to catch him.

r-empire-of-the-sun-1987.plot: A privileged British boy living in Shanghai is separated from his parents when Japan invades. Interned in a prison camp, he adapts with resourcefulness and a fascination for aircraft while the war grinds on.

r-merry-christmas-mr-lawrence-1983.plot: In a Japanese POW camp on Java, a British officer who speaks Japanese tries to bridge two cultures, while the camp's commandant becomes fixated on a defiant new prisoner. A tense clash of honor, guilt and desire.

r-andrei-rublev-1966.plot: A sweeping portrait of medieval Russia told through episodes in the life of the icon painter Andrei Rublev. Amid Tatar raids, cruel princes, famine and religious doubt, the monk loses faith in his art and falls silent, until a young bell-maker's daring work shows him a way back.

r-the-virgin-spring-1960.plot: In medieval Sweden, a wealthy farmer's pampered daughter rides off to deliver candles to church and is attacked by herdsmen on the way. When the killers unknowingly seek shelter at her family's farm, her devout father faces a choice between vengeance and his faith.

r-love-and-death-1975.plot: A cowardly, philosophizing Russian is drafted to fight Napoleon and stumbles into heroism by accident. Afterward his distant cousin, whom he adores, enlists him in a scheme to assassinate the emperor, in a parody of Russian literature and existential angst.

r-8-1963.plot: A celebrated Italian film director suffering from creative block retreats to a spa resort while his next big production stalls. Hounded by producers, actors, his wife and his mistress, he drifts into memories and fantasies as he tries to figure out what film, and what life, he actually wants.

r-about-schmidt-2002.plot: A newly retired Omaha insurance actuary loses his wife unexpectedly and realizes how empty his life has become. He sets off in a motorhome to stop his daughter from marrying a man he considers beneath her.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Jack Nicholson
Actress in a Supporting Role — Kathy Bates

r-murder-on-the-orient-express-1974.plot: Detective Hercule Poirot boards the luxurious Orient Express, which becomes stranded in a snowdrift. When an unpleasant American passenger is found stabbed in his compartment, Poirot questions a carriage full of suspects, each hiding something.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Ingrid Bergman
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Albert Finney

r-death-on-the-nile-1978.plot: A wealthy heiress honeymooning on a Nile steamer is followed by her husband's spurned former fiancee. When the heiress is found shot, Hercule Poirot discovers that nearly every passenger aboard had a reason to want her dead.

r-primal-fear-1996.plot: A fame-hungry Chicago defense lawyer takes the case of a stuttering altar boy accused of murdering an archbishop. As he digs into the case, he uncovers secrets about the church and about his client.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Edward Norton

r-harold-and-maude-1971.plot: A wealthy young man obsessed with death stages fake suicides to unsettle his mother and attends strangers' funerals for fun. At one he meets a free-spirited woman nearing eighty, and their unlikely friendship teaches him how to live.

r-mame-1974.plot: An orphaned boy is sent to live with his flamboyant, free-spirited aunt in Manhattan. Through the Depression and beyond, she loses and regains fortunes, marries into Southern money and fights to keep her nephew from growing up stuffy.

r-travels-with-my-aunt-1972.plot: A staid London bank manager meets his flamboyant aunt at his mother's funeral. She whisks him across Europe on an eccentric journey involving smuggled money, old lovers and a ransom, opening his eyes to a far more colorful life.

setting.place: London, Paris, Istanbul and across Europe

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Maggie Smith

r-sweet-bird-of-youth-1962.plot: A failed actor returns to his Gulf Coast hometown as the companion of a fading, hard-drinking movie star, hoping to use her connections to launch his career. He also wants to win back his old sweetheart, whose powerful father, the town's political boss, wants him gone.

setting.place: St. Cloud, a Gulf Coast town

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Ed Begley
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Geraldine Page
Actress in a Supporting Role — Shirley Knight

r-the-long-hot-summer-1958.plot: A drifter with a reputation for burning barns arrives in a Mississippi town and gets work from the domineering patriarch who runs it. The old man sees him as a match for his strong-willed schoolteacher daughter and a rival for his weak son.

r-can-can-1960.plot: In 1896 Paris, a café owner keeps her Montmartre club open despite the scandalous can-can being banned. Her lawyer lover protects her while a straitlaced young judge tries to shut her down and falls in love with her.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-o-brother-where-art-thou-2000.plot: Three escaped convicts from a Mississippi chain gang go on a journey to recover hidden loot before the land is flooded. Along the way they record a hit song, meet sirens and a one-eyed Bible salesman, and get tangled in a governor's race.

r-48-hrs-1982.plot: A hard-bitten San Francisco cop springs a fast-talking convict from prison for two days to help track down the convict's former partners, a pair of killers. The mismatched duo clash constantly while closing in.

r-obsession-1976.plot: A New Orleans businessman loses his wife and daughter in a botched kidnapping. Years later in Florence he meets a young woman who looks exactly like his late wife and falls under her spell, unaware of the deception surrounding him.

r-my-cousin-vinny-1992.plot: Two young New Yorkers driving through Alabama are wrongly charged with murder. Their only hope is a brash, inexperienced lawyer cousin from Brooklyn, aided by his sharp-witted fiancée.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Marisa Tomei

r-three-days-of-the-condor-1975.plot: A bookish CIA researcher who reads novels for hidden codes returns from lunch to find his entire office murdered. On the run in New York and unsure whom in his own agency to trust, he forces a stranger to shelter him while he uncovers the reason.

r-from-russia-with-love-1963.plot: British agent James Bond is sent to Istanbul to help a Soviet clerk defect with a valuable decoding machine. What he does not know is that the operation is a trap set by the criminal organization SPECTRE, which has sent a deadly assassin after him.

r-saturday-night-and-sunday-morning-1960.plot: A rebellious young Nottingham factory worker lives for weekend drinking and an affair with a coworker's wife. When the affair has consequences and a new girlfriend expects commitment, he must reckon with growing up.

r-look-back-in-anger-1959.plot: A university-educated young man running a market sweet stall vents his fury at class privilege on his upper-middle-class wife. When her friend moves into their cramped flat, the household tensions boil over.

r-life-at-the-top-1965.plot: Ten years after marrying into a rich Yorkshire family, a working-class man who clawed his way up finds his success hollow. Trapped in a job under his father-in-law and a cold marriage, he turns to an affair and a move to London in search of something more.

r-the-seven-year-itch-1955.plot: With his wife and son away for the summer, a mild-mannered Manhattan publisher's imagination runs wild when a beautiful young model moves in upstairs. His fantasies and guilt collide during a sweltering week.

r-mrs-doubtfire-1993.plot: After a divorce limits his time with his children, an out-of-work voice actor disguises himself as an elderly Scottish nanny to be hired by his ex-wife, so he can stay close to his kids.

r-sophie-s-choice-1982.plot: In postwar Brooklyn, an aspiring Southern writer befriends his neighbors: a volatile, charismatic scientist and his lover, a Polish Catholic survivor of Auschwitz. Slowly, her guarded memories of the war come to light.

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Meryl Streep

r-the-boy-in-the-striped-pajamas-2008.plot: The eight-year-old son of a Nazi officer moves with his family to a remote house near a fenced compound. Bored and curious, he befriends a Jewish boy his own age on the other side of the wire, without understanding what the place really is.
r-the-boy-in-the-striped-pajamas-2008.source: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas

setting.place: Berlin; extermination camp in occupied Poland

r-ida-2013.plot: In 1960s Poland, a young novice nun about to take her vows is sent to meet her only relative, a worldly, hard-drinking aunt. The aunt reveals that the girl is Jewish, and the two set out on a road trip to learn what happened to their family during the war.

r-nightmare-alley-1947.plot: An ambitious carnival worker learns a mind-reading code from a fading act and uses it to become a celebrated nightclub mentalist. Teaming with a calculating psychologist, he moves into bigger cons involving wealthy believers, but his rise sets up a steep fall.

r-halloween-1978.plot: Fifteen years after murdering his sister as a child, a silent killer escapes from a psychiatric hospital and returns to his Illinois hometown on Halloween. He stalks a shy teenage babysitter and her friends while his psychiatrist races to find him.

r-women-in-love-1969.plot: In a coal-mining town in the English Midlands after World War I, two sisters become involved with two close friends: a thoughtful school inspector and the cold, domineering heir to the local mine. Their relationships become an intense struggle over love, freedom and possession.

setting.place: English Midlands and the Swiss Alps

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Glenda Jackson

r-this-sporting-life-1963.plot: A brash, angry Yorkshire coal miner muscles his way into professional rugby league and finds money and local fame. Off the field he pursues a tormented relationship with his widowed landlady, who cannot return the love he demands in his clumsy, aggressive way.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Richard Harris
Actress in a Leading Role — Rachel Roberts

r-the-alamo-2004.plot: During the Texas Revolution, a small garrison led by William Travis, Jim Bowie and Davy Crockett holds the San Antonio mission against Santa Anna's much larger Mexican army. Their stand inspires Sam Houston's later campaign.

setting.place: San Antonio and San Jacinto, Texas

r-zulu-1964.plot: In 1879, a small garrison of British soldiers at the mission station of Rorke's Drift learns that a huge Zulu army is coming toward them. Two officers with very different backgrounds must organize a defense of the hospital and storehouse against overwhelming odds.

r-avanti-1972.plot: A brisk American executive travels to an Italian island to collect his father's body and discovers his father had a long-running secret romance there. He meets the daughter of his father's lover, and amid bureaucratic farce the two begin to repeat history.

r-when-harry-met-sally-1989.plot: Harry and Sally meet sharing a drive from Chicago to New York and disagree about whether men and women can be just friends. Over twelve years of chance encounters, they become close friends and wonder if they are more.

r-walkabout-1971.plot: After a shocking incident leaves them stranded in the Australian outback, a city schoolgirl and her little brother wander lost in the desert. A young Aboriginal man on his own coming-of-age journey helps them survive, though the cultures barely understand each other.

r-my-brilliant-career-1979.plot: A headstrong young woman stuck on a poor farm in the Australian bush dreams of becoming a writer. Sent to live with her well-off grandmother, she is courted by a wealthy, kind landowner but must decide whether marriage fits her ambitions.

r-the-man-from-snowy-river-1982.plot: After his father's death, a young man works on a wealthy rancher's station in the Australian high country and falls for the rancher's daughter. He must prove himself when a prized colt escapes with a mob of wild horses.

r-jean-de-florette-1986.plot: In rural Provence, a scheming landowner and his nephew covet a neighboring farm for its spring. When a city-bred hunchback inherits it and tries to farm it, they secretly block the water and watch him struggle.

r-manon-of-the-spring-1986.plot: Years after the events of Jean de Florette, the dead farmer's daughter lives wild in the Provençal hills. Discovering who ruined her father, she plots a reckoning that reveals devastating secrets.

r-marius-1931.plot: On the Marseille waterfront, the son of a gruff bar owner is torn between his love for a young shellfish seller and an overwhelming longing to go to sea. First part of Marcel Pagnol's Marseille trilogy, warm and talky, full of local color.

r-nuremberg-2025.plot: After World War II, U.S. Army psychiatrist Douglas Kelley is assigned to evaluate captured Nazi leaders before their trial. His sessions with Hermann Göring become a tense battle of wills as the Allies prepare an unprecedented tribunal.

r-labyrinth-of-lies-2014.plot: In late-1950s West Germany, a young idealistic prosecutor begins investigating former SS members who served at Auschwitz. Facing a society eager to forget and obstruction at every level, his inquiry lays the groundwork for the Frankfurt Auschwitz trials.

r-where-eagles-dare-1968.plot: In winter during World War II, a British commando team and an American Ranger parachute into the Bavarian Alps to rescue a captured U.S. general held in a mountaintop castle reachable only by cable car. Treachery within the team suggests the mission is not what it appears.

r-the-dirty-dozen-1967.plot: Before D-Day, a rebellious U.S. Army major is ordered to train twelve convicted soldiers, most facing death or long sentences, for a near-suicidal mission. They must parachute behind German lines and attack a chateau where high-ranking Nazi officers gather, in exchange for pardons.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — John Cassavetes

r-force-10-from-navarone-1978.plot: Two veterans of the Navarone raid are sent to Yugoslavia to unmask a traitor among the partisans. They attach themselves to an American commando unit, Force 10, whose real target is a vital bridge used by German forces.

r-the-color-of-money-1986.plot: Retired pool hustler Fast Eddie Felson, now a liquor salesman, spots a cocky young player with raw talent. He takes the kid and his girlfriend on the road to teach him the art of the hustle, and rediscovers his own game.

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Paul Newman
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio

r-the-cincinnati-kid-1965.plot: In Depression-era New Orleans, a cocky young stud-poker player wants to prove himself against the aging master of the game. As the high-stakes showdown approaches, a wealthy sore loser pressures the dealer to rig the cards, and the Kid's love life complicates things further.

r-grease-1978.plot: After a summer romance, a leather-jacketed greaser and a wholesome Australian girl are surprised to find themselves at the same high school. Pressure from his gang and her new friends complicates their love through dances, drag races and graduation.

r-in-the-heights-2021.plot: Over a sweltering summer in Washington Heights, bodega owner Usnavi dreams of returning to the Dominican Republic. He and his neighbors chase their ambitions as a winning lottery ticket and a blackout shake up the tight-knit community.

r-sanjuro-1962.plot: A scruffy, sharp-witted ronin stumbles upon nine naive young samurai trying to expose corruption in their clan. Unable to leave them to their own blunders, he takes charge, outwitting the scheming officials who have kidnapped the clan's chamberlain while trying to keep bloodshed to a minimum.

r-a-fistful-of-dollars-1964.plot: A laconic gunslinger rides into a Mexican border town controlled by two feuding families of smugglers. Seeing an opportunity, he plays the rival clans against each other for profit, but his scheme turns dangerous when he crosses the most ruthless of them.

r-miller-s-crossing-1990.plot: In a Prohibition-era city, the cunning right-hand man of an Irish crime boss plays rival gangs against each other after a dispute over a crooked bookie threatens to ignite a war, with his own loyalties increasingly hard to read.

r-samurai-rebellion-1967.plot: In 18th-century Japan, a veteran samurai's son is ordered to marry the lord's discarded mistress. The arranged marriage unexpectedly becomes a loving one, but when the lord demands the wife back, father and son must choose between obedience to their clan and defending their family.

r-the-twilight-samurai-2002.plot: A widowed low-ranking samurai, nicknamed for hurrying home each dusk to care for his daughters and senile mother, lives in quiet poverty. When an old love returns and his clan orders him to fight a dangerous swordsman, he must weigh duty against the family he cherishes.

r-the-sword-of-doom-1966.plot: In the turbulent final years of the shogunate, a brilliant but utterly cold swordsman kills without remorse and drifts into the service of political assassins. As his crimes pile up, the people he has wronged seek revenge, and his own mind begins to crack.

r-khartoum-1966.plot: In the 1880s, British general Charles Gordon is sent to Sudan to evacuate Egyptians from Khartoum as a religious leader known as the Mahdi gathers a powerful army. Gordon instead stays and digs in, setting up a fateful confrontation with the Mahdi as London hesitates to send help.

r-lion-of-the-desert-1980.plot: In Italian-occupied Libya, an elderly Bedouin teacher, Omar Mukhtar, leads a long guerrilla resistance. Mussolini sends a ruthless general to crush the rebellion with concentration camps and barbed wire, and the two sides fight a bitter war.

r-bye-bye-birdie-1963.plot: When a hip-swiveling rock-and-roll idol is drafted into the Army, a struggling songwriter and his girlfriend arrange a publicity stunt: the star will kiss one lucky teenage fan goodbye on live TV. The chosen girl's small Ohio town is thrown into chaos.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-unsinkable-molly-brown-1964.plot: A spirited, uneducated girl from rural Missouri heads to Colorado determined to get rich, and marries a miner who strikes it big. Snubbed by Denver high society, she tries to win acceptance at home and in Europe, and her famous resilience is tested aboard the Titanic.

setting.place: Missouri, Leadville and Denver, Colorado; Europe

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Debbie Reynolds
Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-in-the-heart-of-the-sea-2015.plot: In 1820 the whaling ship Essex is attacked and sunk by an enormous sperm whale in the Pacific. The surviving crew face starvation and desperate choices adrift for months, a story later recounted to Herman Melville.
r-in-the-heart-of-the-sea-2015.source: In the Heart of the Sea (Nathaniel Philbrick)

r-a-bridge-too-far-1977.plot: In 1944 the Allies launch a massive airborne operation to seize a chain of bridges in the Netherlands and push into Germany. An all-star cast traces the plan from confident headquarters to paratroopers holding out at Arnhem as things go wrong.

r-battle-of-the-bulge-1965.plot: In December 1944, an American intelligence officer suspects that Germany is preparing a major offensive, but his superiors believe the war is nearly won. A determined Panzer commander then leads a surprise tank assault through the Ardennes forest, and fuel becomes the key to the battle.

r-summer-of-42-1971.plot: A teenage boy spending the wartime summer on Nantucket fumbles through adolescence with his friends. He becomes infatuated with a young woman whose husband has gone off to fight, and their brief connection shapes his memory of growing up.

r-just-mercy-2019.plot: Young Harvard-trained lawyer Bryan Stevenson moves to Alabama to defend death-row inmates. He takes on the case of Walter McMillian, sentenced to death for a murder despite overwhelming evidence of his innocence.
r-just-mercy-2019.source: Just Mercy: A Story of Justice and Redemption

r-the-immigrant-2013.plot: In 1921, a Polish woman arriving at Ellis Island is separated from her ailing sister and falls under the control of a charming, manipulative man who pushes her into burlesque and prostitution. A magician's arrival complicates her desperate struggle to reunite with her sister.

r-golden-door-2006.plot: In early twentieth-century Sicily, a poor peasant widower sells everything to take his family to America, the land of rumored rivers of milk. On the crossing he meets a mysterious Englishwoman, and on arrival at Ellis Island they face humiliating inspections.

r-in-america-2002.plot: An Irish family, grieving the death of their young son, moves illegally into a run-down Manhattan tenement. Told through the eyes of the eldest daughter, they struggle to survive and find hope, helped by a reclusive Nigerian artist downstairs.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Djimon Hounsou
Actress in a Leading Role — Samantha Morton

r-stray-dog-1949.plot: A rookie Tokyo detective has his pistol stolen on a crowded bus during a summer heat wave. When the gun turns up in crimes, he teams with a seasoned veteran to search the city's postwar underworld before it is used again.

r-ransom-1996.plot: When his young son is kidnapped, a self-made airline tycoon refuses to pay the ransom. Instead, he goes on television and turns the money into a bounty on the kidnappers' heads.

r-zodiac-2007.plot: A newspaper cartoonist, a crime reporter and a homicide detective each become consumed by the hunt for the Zodiac Killer, who taunts the Bay Area with coded letters. Over decades, the obsession costs them careers, health and relationships.

r-little-big-man-1970.plot: A 121-year-old man recounts his improbable life in the Old West: raised by the Cheyenne, then moving between white and Native worlds as a gunslinger, con man, drunk and scout. His adventures lead him to General Custer and the Battle of the Little Bighorn.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Chief Dan George

r-to-sir-with-love-1967.plot: An engineer from British Guiana who cannot find work in his field takes a teaching job at a tough school in London's East End. Facing an unruly, cynical class about to leave school, he throws out the textbooks and treats them as adults, earning their respect.

r-a-patch-of-blue-1965.plot: A blind young white woman, kept nearly a prisoner by her abusive mother, meets a kind Black office worker in a city park. He begins to help her learn independence, and a tender friendship grows, though she does not know he is Black and her bigoted mother would never allow it.
r-a-patch-of-blue-1965.source: Be Ready with Bells and Drums

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Shelley Winters
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Elizabeth Hartman

r-von-ryan-s-express-1965.plot: In 1943, an American pilot shot down over Italy becomes the senior officer in a prison camp full of British soldiers who resent his cautious leadership. After Italy surrenders, the prisoners are loaded onto a train bound for Germany, and he leads a bold plan to seize it and escape.

r-joseph-andrews-1977.plot: A handsome, virtuous footman in eighteenth-century England resists the advances of his amorous employer and is dismissed. Setting off to find his sweetheart, he travels the countryside with a kindly parson through a series of bawdy misadventures.

r-the-three-musketeers-1973.plot: A brash young Gascon comes to Paris hoping to join the King's Musketeers and falls in with three swaggering veterans. Together they try to foil Cardinal Richelieu's plot to disgrace the Queen, in a swashbuckler full of slapstick and swordplay.

r-love-friendship-2016.plot: Lady Susan Vernon, a widowed, scheming beauty, retreats to her in-laws' estate while rumors of her flirtations swirl. There she sets about securing advantageous husbands for both herself and her reluctant daughter.

r-mary-queen-of-scots-1971.plot: The young Catholic queen returns from France to rule a turbulent Scotland, where marriages, murders and rebellious lords undermine her. Forced to flee to England, she becomes a dangerous rival and prisoner of her cousin Elizabeth I.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Vanessa Redgrave

r-lady-jane-1986.plot: Teenage Lady Jane Grey is pushed into an arranged marriage and onto the English throne by ambitious nobles after Edward VI's death. She and her husband grow to love each other during her brief, doomed reign.

r-fail-safe-1964.plot: A mechanical error sends a squadron of American nuclear bombers on an irrevocable course toward Moscow. As recall attempts fail, the President, working with Soviet leaders over a hotline, faces an unthinkable decision to prevent all-out nuclear war.

setting.place: Washington, D.C., Omaha and New York

r-in-the-loop-2009.plot: A hapless British cabinet minister makes an offhand remark that war in the Middle East is unforeseeable, and suddenly finds himself a pawn in transatlantic maneuvering. Spin doctors, generals and diplomats in London and Washington scramble over whether to go to war.

r-the-death-of-stalin-2017.plot: When Joseph Stalin suddenly collapses in 1953, the members of his inner circle scramble in a chaotic, often absurd struggle to take power. This sharp satire depicts the terror and incompetence of the Soviet leadership.
writers: Fabien Nury and Thierry Robin (graphic novel)

r-chitty-chitty-bang-bang-1968.plot: An eccentric widowed inventor restores a battered racing car for his two children. On a seaside outing he spins a fantastical tale in which the car flies and floats, and the family is carried off to the kingdom of Vulgaria, where a toymaker's tyrannical baron has banned all children.

setting.place: English countryside and the fictional Vulgaria

r-bedknobs-and-broomsticks-1971.plot: In 1940, three London children evacuated to the English countryside are placed with a woman secretly learning witchcraft by mail. With an enchanted bed and a con man posing as a professor, they travel to an animated island searching for a spell she hopes will help defend Britain.
r-bedknobs-and-broomsticks-1971.source: The Magic Bed-Knob and Bonfires and Broomsticks

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-saving-mr-banks-2013.plot: In 1961, Walt Disney finally persuades prickly author P.L. Travers to visit Los Angeles to discuss adapting Mary Poppins. As she fights the studio's every idea, flashbacks to her Australian childhood reveal why the story matters so much to her.

r-pretty-woman-1990.plot: A wealthy corporate raider hires a Hollywood Boulevard sex worker to be his companion for a week of business events. As she navigates high society, the arrangement slowly turns into something both of them did not expect.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Julia Roberts

r-the-face-of-another-1966.plot: A businessman whose face was destroyed in an industrial accident gets a lifelike mask from his psychiatrist. Hidden behind a stranger's face, he decides to seduce his own wife to test her, while the doctor watches his patient's personality change in disturbing ways.

r-onibaba-1964.plot: During a medieval civil war, a woman and her daughter-in-law survive in a vast field of reeds by killing stray samurai and selling their armor. When a neighbor returns from the fighting and starts a relationship with the younger woman, the older one turns to a sinister demon mask.

r-kwaidan-1964.plot: Four ghost stories drawn from Japanese folklore: a samurai who abandons his wife, a woodcutter spared by a snow spirit, a blind musician who sings for an audience of the dead, and a man who sees a face reflected in a cup of tea.
r-kwaidan-1964.source: Kwaidan: Stories and Studies of Strange Things

r-never-on-sunday-1960.plot: An American scholar obsessed with ancient Greek ideals visits Piraeus and meets a free-spirited, happy prostitute. He sets out to reform and educate her, with comic results for both.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Melina Mercouri

r-mediterraneo-1991.plot: A small unit of misfit Italian soldiers is posted to a remote Greek island during World War II. Cut off from communication and forgotten by their command, they settle into island life and the war fades away.

setting.place: A Greek island in the Aegean

r-captain-corelli-s-mandolin-2001.plot: During World War II, Italian troops occupy the Greek island of Cephalonia. A cheerful, music-loving Italian captain falls for a local doctor's daughter, already engaged to a fisherman fighting with the resistance, before the war turns brutal.

r-the-odd-couple-1968.plot: After his wife throws him out, a fussy, neurotic news writer moves in with his divorced friend, a slovenly sportswriter. Their clashing habits turn the apartment into a battleground and strain the friends' weekly poker game.

r-captain-fantastic-2016.plot: A father raises his six children off the grid in the Pacific Northwest forest with a rigorous intellectual and physical education. After a family tragedy, they must journey into conventional society, challenging his ideas about parenthood.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Viggo Mortensen

r-breakfast-at-tiffany-s-1961.plot: A struggling writer moves into a Manhattan brownstone and becomes fascinated by his neighbor, a charming, flighty young woman who lives on the generosity of wealthy men and dreams of marrying rich. As they grow close, the truth about her past complicates both their plans.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Audrey Hepburn

r-la-dolce-vita-1960.plot: A Roman gossip journalist drifts through a series of nights and days among celebrities, aristocrats and intellectuals. Torn between serious ambition and empty pleasure, he chases meaning amid decadence.

r-anna-karenina-2012.plot: In Imperial Russia, the aristocratic wife of a senior official falls into a passionate affair with a dashing cavalry officer. Staged largely within a theatrical frame, the story contrasts her doomed defiance of society with a landowner's sincere search for love.

r-war-and-peace-1966.plot: During the Napoleonic Wars, the lives of several Russian aristocratic families intertwine: an awkward, searching heir, a disillusioned prince and a vivacious young countess. Their loves, losses and quests for meaning unfold against the battles of Austerlitz and Borodino and the burning of Moscow.

r-django-1966.plot: A mysterious former soldier trudges into a muddy, half-abandoned border town dragging a coffin behind him. He soon finds himself between a gang of red-hooded racists and a band of Mexican revolutionaries, and plays both sides in pursuit of revenge and a cache of gold.

r-the-big-gundown-1966.plot: A renowned bounty hunter with political ambitions agrees to track down a Mexican peasant accused of raping and murdering a young girl. The wily fugitive keeps slipping away across Texas and Mexico, and the hunter begins to suspect the powerful men who hired him are hiding the truth.

r-voyage-of-the-damned-1976.plot: In 1939 a German liner carries hundreds of Jewish refugees from Hamburg to Cuba, part of a Nazi propaganda ploy. When Havana refuses to let most of them land, the passengers face being sent back to Europe as the world looks away.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Lee Grant

r-the-garden-of-the-finzi-continis-1970.plot: In Ferrara under Mussolini, a wealthy Jewish family opens its walled estate to young friends as anti-Semitic laws close other doors. A young man from a middle-class Jewish family falls in love with the family's elusive daughter while the threat of deportation draws closer.

r-annie-1982.plot: A plucky orphan escapes the clutches of a drunken orphanage matron when she is invited to spend a week at the mansion of a gruff billionaire. As she wins him over, schemers plot to cash in on her.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-other-boleyn-girl-2008.plot: Pushed by their ambitious family, sisters Anne and Mary Boleyn compete for the affections of King Henry VIII. Mary wins him first, but Anne's ruthless maneuvering for the crown reshapes England and puts both sisters' lives in peril.

r-alfie-2004.plot: A charming British limo driver in Manhattan juggles a string of romances while avoiding any real commitment, narrating his exploits directly to the audience. Gradually the consequences of his carefree womanizing catch up with him.

r-shampoo-1975.plot: A popular Beverly Hills hairdresser juggles affairs with several women, including his girlfriend, his ex and the wife of the businessman he hopes will finance his own salon. Over one election day in 1968, his romantic entanglements catch up with him.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Lee Grant
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jack Warden

r-georgy-girl-1966.plot: A plain, warm-hearted young woman in swinging London shares a flat with her glamorous, selfish roommate and is quietly drawn to the roommate's boyfriend. Meanwhile, her parents' wealthy, much older employer offers her a formal contract to become his mistress.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — James Mason
Actress in a Leading Role — Lynn Redgrave

r-army-of-shadows-1969.plot: In Nazi-occupied France, a respected engineer who secretly leads a Resistance cell escapes a prison camp and returns to clandestine work. He and his comrades face constant danger, impossible choices and the grim duty of dealing with traitors in their own ranks.

setting.place: Occupied France (Lyon, Marseille, Paris) and London

r-burn-1969.plot: In the 19th century, a British agent is sent to a Portuguese-ruled Caribbean island to stir up a slave revolt that will serve British sugar interests. Years later he returns to crush the very rebellion leader he once cultivated, now a man fighting for real independence.

r-hunger-2008.plot: Inside Northern Ireland's Maze Prison, IRA inmates protest for political status amid brutal conditions and violent guards. Bobby Sands debates the morality of a hunger strike with a priest, then begins a fast that his body cannot survive.

r-the-great-silence-1968.plot: During a brutal winter in the Utah mountains, bounty hunters prey on starving outlaws who have fled into the snow. A mute gunfighter who only kills in self-defense is hired by a widow to avenge her husband against a cold-blooded bounty killer, leading to a grim confrontation.

r-1941-1979.plot: Days after Pearl Harbor, panic grips Los Angeles as a Japanese submarine surfaces off the coast looking for Hollywood. Bumbling soldiers, a crazed pilot, a dance contest and frightened civilians collide in an escalating slapstick of destruction.

r-the-mouse-that-roared-1959.plot: The bankrupt tiny European duchy of Grand Fenwick declares war on the United States, planning to lose quickly and collect aid. Its archer army accidentally wins, capturing a doomsday bomb in New York.

r-55-days-at-peking-1963.plot: In 1900, as the Boxer uprising sweeps China, foreigners in Peking's diplomatic quarter are besieged by Boxers backed by the imperial court. An American Marine officer and a British diplomat organize a desperate defense while waiting for an international relief force.
r-55-days-at-peking-1963.source: Siege of the International Legations (Boxer Rebellion)

r-the-wind-and-the-lion-1975.plot: A Berber chieftain kidnaps an American widow and her children in Morocco, provoking an international crisis. President Theodore Roosevelt uses the incident to flex American power, while the captive and her captor develop grudging respect.

r-papillon-1973.plot: A French safecracker convicted of a murder he says he didn't commit is shipped to the brutal penal colony in French Guiana. He befriends a timid forger and endures solitary confinement and repeated failed escapes, never giving up on freedom.

r-carnage-2011.plot: After one boy injures another in a Brooklyn park, the two sets of parents meet in an apartment to settle the matter civilly. Polite conversation slowly collapses into bickering, shifting alliances and open hostility.

r-closer-2004.plot: Over several years in London, two couples, an obituary writer, a stripper, a photographer and a dermatologist, become entangled in a cycle of attraction, deception and betrayal. Their relationships are dissected through raw, cutting conversations.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Clive Owen
Actress in a Supporting Role — Natalie Portman

r-long-day-s-journey-into-night-1962.plot: Over one long summer day at their Connecticut seaside home, the Tyrone family confront each other's failings: a miserly actor father, a mother relapsing into morphine addiction, an alcoholic elder son and a younger son who is seriously ill. Love and blame mix as day fades into night.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Katharine Hepburn

r-badlands-1973.plot: A disaffected young garbage collector romances a naive teenage girl in a small South Dakota town. After a deadly confrontation with her father, the pair flee across the plains toward Montana, leaving a trail of killings as she narrates in detached tones.

r-thelma-louise-1991.plot: Two friends set off on a weekend getaway, but a violent encounter at a roadside bar turns them into fugitives. Pursued across the Southwest, they find unexpected freedom on the road.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Geena Davis
Actress in a Leading Role — Susan Sarandon

r-gun-crazy-1950.plot: A young man obsessed with guns since childhood falls for a sharpshooter in a traveling carnival. Her hunger for money and excitement draws him into a series of robberies, and the couple's crime spree spirals beyond their control.

setting.place: Small-town America and the open road; California

r-willy-wonka-the-chocolate-factory-1971.plot: A reclusive candy maker hides golden tickets in his chocolate bars, inviting five children inside his mysterious factory. A poor but kind boy wins one and tours a world of wonders alongside spoiled rivals who each meet a fitting fate.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-20-000-leagues-under-the-sea-1954.plot: In 1868, a professor, his assistant and a brash harpooner hunting a sea monster are captured by Captain Nemo aboard his advanced submarine Nautilus. They marvel at his underwater world but grow alarmed at his vendetta against warships.
r-20-000-leagues-under-the-sea-1954.source: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas

r-meet-the-parents-2000.plot: A male nurse plans to propose to his girlfriend during a weekend visit to her parents' home. Her intimidating father, a retired CIA operative, takes an instant dislike to him, and every attempt to impress the family goes disastrously wrong.

r-a-raisin-in-the-sun-1961.plot: A working-class Black family crowded into a small Chicago apartment awaits a life-insurance check after the father's death. The mother, her restless son, his wife and her ambitious daughter each have different dreams for the money, and a plan to buy a house in a white neighborhood tests them all.

r-loving-2016.plot: Richard and Mildred Loving, an interracial couple in Virginia, are arrested for marrying and banished from the state. Their quiet determination to live together leads to a landmark Supreme Court case.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Ruth Negga

r-they-call-me-mister-tibbs-1970.plot: San Francisco police detective Virgil Tibbs investigates the murder of a call girl, and the prime suspect is a respected street preacher and political activist who is also his friend. While working the case he also tries to handle trouble with his young son at home.
r-they-call-me-mister-tibbs-1970.source: In the Heat of the Night (sequel)

r-carnal-knowledge-1971.plot: Two college roommates, one cynical and one idealistic, compare notes on women from the late 1940s onward. Over two decades their relationships, marriages and affairs reveal how differently, and how unhappily, each of them handles love and sex.

setting.place: Amherst College and New York City

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Ann-Margret

r-rushmore-1998.plot: An eccentric, overachieving fifteen-year-old at a private school is passionate about extracurriculars but failing his classes. He befriends a gloomy industrialist and they both fall for the same first-grade teacher, leading to an escalating feud.

r-solaris-1972.plot: A psychologist is sent to a space station orbiting a mysterious ocean planet to assess whether the troubled mission should continue. There he finds the crew haunted by physical manifestations of their memories, including his dead wife.

r-silent-running-1971.plot: In a future where Earth has lost its plant life, the last forests survive in domes aboard freighters in deep space. When the crew is ordered to destroy them, one devoted botanist rebels to save the gardens, aided only by small maintenance robots.

r-contact-1997.plot: A radio astronomer detects a signal from deep space that contains plans for a mysterious machine. As governments and religious groups react, she fights to be the one who travels where the signal leads.

r-funny-lady-1975.plot: Continuing the story of Fanny Brice, the Ziegfeld star recovers from her failed marriage and teams with a brash songwriter and showman, Billy Rose. Their professional partnership becomes a rocky marriage as she struggles to let go of her first love.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-gypsy-1962.plot: A relentless stage mother drags her two daughters around the dying vaudeville circuit, determined to make the younger, more talented one a star. When that daughter runs off, she turns her ambitions on the shy older girl, who eventually finds fame in an unexpected place: burlesque.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-yentl-1983.plot: In early-1900s Eastern Europe, a young Jewish woman hungry to study the Talmud disguises herself as a man to enter a yeshiva. Her secret becomes tangled when she falls for her study partner.

won: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Amy Irving

r-scrooge-1970.plot: A miserly London moneylender who despises Christmas is visited on Christmas Eve by the ghost of his late business partner and three spirits. They show him his past, present and future, giving him one last chance to change his ways, all told with song.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-effect-of-gamma-rays-on-man-in-the.plot: A bitter, eccentric widow raises two daughters in a cluttered house while scheming and lashing out at the world. Her shy younger daughter finds hope in a school science project with irradiated seeds, while the older girl grows unstable.
r-the-effect-of-gamma-rays-on-man-in-the.source: The Effect of Gamma Rays on Man-in-the-Moon Marigolds

r-summer-wishes-winter-dreams-1973.plot: A middle-aged New York woman, unsettled by her mother's death and haunting dreams, feels estranged from her husband and grown children. A trip to the European battlefield where her husband fought prompts her to face her regrets.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Joanne Woodward
Actress in a Supporting Role — Sylvia Sidney

r-alice-doesn-t-live-here-anymore-1974.plot: Suddenly widowed, a woman sets off with her wisecracking young son toward her childhood home in California, hoping to restart her singing career. Stuck in the Southwest, she takes jobs in bars and diners and meets a rancher who might be different.

setting.place: New Mexico; Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Ellen Burstyn
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Diane Ladd

r-the-taming-of-the-shrew-1967.plot: In Renaissance Padua, a rich merchant will not let his sweet younger daughter marry until her fierce, sharp-tongued older sister finds a husband. A boisterous fortune hunter takes up the challenge, and a riotous battle of wills follows.

r-robin-and-marian-1976.plot: An aging Robin Hood returns to England after years fighting in the Crusades and finds Maid Marian has become an abbess. Reunited with his old band, he rekindles their love and takes on the Sheriff of Nottingham one last time.

r-the-private-lives-of-elizabeth-and-ess.plot: The aging Queen Elizabeth I is in love with the young, ambitious Earl of Essex. When he returns from victory, their passion and his political ambitions lead to rebellion.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-assassination-of-jesse-james-by-th.plot: In the last months of his life, outlaw Jesse James lives under assumed names while paranoia frays his remaining gang. Young Robert Ford, who idolized James since childhood, drifts into his orbit and becomes torn between hero worship and resentment.
r-the-assassination-of-jesse-james-by-th.source: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Casey Affleck

r-the-long-riders-1980.plot: After the Civil War, the James and Younger brothers lead a gang of outlaws robbing banks and trains across Missouri. Pursued by Pinkerton detectives and growing weary, they plan an ambitious raid on a bank in Northfield, Minnesota.

r-the-matchmaker-1958.plot: A widowed matchmaker is hired by a wealthy, tightfisted Yonkers merchant to find him a wife, but she secretly plans to marry him herself. Meanwhile his two clerks sneak off to New York City for a day of adventure.

r-thoroughly-modern-millie-1967.plot: In 1922, a small-town girl arrives in New York determined to become a modern flapper and marry her wealthy boss. Living in a hotel for young women, she befriends a sweet orphan and slowly realizes that the landlady is kidnapping residents for a white-slavery ring.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Carol Channing
Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-scarecrow-1973.plot: A hot-tempered ex-convict and a playful former sailor meet while hitchhiking in California and team up to open a car wash in Pittsburgh. Their journey east, with stops to see family, tests the friendship and exposes each man's fragility.

setting.place: Road from California to Detroit and Pittsburgh

r-the-panic-in-needle-park-1971.plot: A young woman falls for a charming small-time dealer around a Manhattan square known for drug trade. Through him she slides into heroin addiction, and their love story becomes a cycle of dependence, hustling, arrests and betrayal.

setting.place: Upper West Side, New York City

r-marathon-man-1976.plot: A history graduate student and marathon runner in New York is pulled into his brother's secret life when a fugitive Nazi war criminal surfaces to retrieve hidden diamonds. Suspecting the student knows something, the old dentist subjects him to terrifying interrogation.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Laurence Olivier

r-state-of-siege-1972.plot: Urban guerrillas in a Latin American country kidnap an American official working with the local police. As they interrogate him and the government refuses to negotiate, his role in training security forces in torture and repression comes to light.

r-investigation-of-a-citizen-above-suspi.plot: On the day he is promoted to head Rome's political intelligence unit, a powerful police inspector murders his mistress and deliberately leaves clues pointing to himself. He watches to see whether anyone will dare accuse a man of his authority.

r-the-parallax-view-1974.plot: After witnesses to a senator's assassination start dying, a reporter digs into the case and uncovers a shadowy corporation that recruits assassins. He goes undercover to infiltrate it, unaware how far its reach extends.

setting.place: Seattle and the Pacific Northwest; Los Angeles

r-the-poseidon-adventure-1972.plot: On New Year's Eve, an aging ocean liner is capsized by a tsunami, turning the ship upside down. A defiant preacher leads a small group of survivors upward toward the hull through flooding, fire and wreckage, hoping to reach rescue.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Shelley Winters

r-airport-1975-1974.plot: A small plane collides with a Boeing 747 in mid-flight, killing or disabling the cockpit crew. A flight attendant must keep the jumbo jet in the air while experts on the ground devise a daring plan to get a pilot aboard.

setting.place: Airliner over Utah; Salt Lake City

r-airplane-1980.plot: A former fighter pilot with a fear of flying follows his ex-girlfriend, a flight attendant, onto a passenger jet. When food poisoning knocks out the crew, he must land the plane, guided by a deadpan doctor and a frazzled ground team, amid nonstop sight gags.

setting.place: Airliner from Los Angeles to Chicago

r-the-king-of-marvin-gardens-1972.plot: A withdrawn Philadelphia late-night radio monologist is summoned to off-season Atlantic City by his brash older brother, who has a grand plan to buy a Hawaiian island. Caught up with his brother's two female companions, he watches the scheme unravel.

r-easy-rider-1969.plot: After a cocaine deal, two bikers ride their motorcycles from Los Angeles toward New Orleans for Mardi Gras. Along the way they meet a hippie commune, a boozy small-town lawyer and the deep hostility of a conservative America that does not welcome their freedom.

setting.place: American Southwest and South, Los Angeles to New Orleans

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jack Nicholson

r-two-lane-blacktop-1971.plot: Two laconic young men drift across the American Southwest in a souped-up Chevy, racing for cash. They pick up a hitchhiking girl and agree to a cross-country race against a talkative stranger in a new GTO, though the destination matters less than the road.

r-the-way-we-were-1973.plot: A fiercely political Jewish activist and an easygoing, privileged WASP writer meet in college and later fall in love. Their marriage weathers wartime and Hollywood, but their clashing values come to a head during the anti-communist blacklist era.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Barbra Streisand

r-the-notebook-2004.plot: In a nursing home, an elderly man reads a love story to a woman with dementia. The tale follows a poor young mill worker and a wealthy girl who fall for each other in 1940s South Carolina, only to be separated by her family and the war.

r-the-fault-in-our-stars-2014.plot: Two teenagers with cancer meet at a support group and fall in love. Sharing a passion for a novel with an unresolved ending, they travel to Amsterdam to meet its reclusive author.

r-kelly-s-heroes-1970.plot: In 1944 France, an American private learns that a stash of Nazi gold bars is held in a bank behind enemy lines. He recruits a band of fellow soldiers, a hippie tank commander and an opportunistic supply sergeant for an unauthorized mission to steal it for themselves.

r-good-morning-vietnam-1987.plot: A motor-mouthed DJ arrives in Saigon to host the Armed Forces Radio morning show. His irreverent riffs and rock music thrill the troops but infuriate his superiors, while the war becomes impossible to joke away.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Robin Williams

r-macarthur-1977.plot: General Douglas MacArthur's career is traced from his escape from the Philippines in 1942 through the Pacific campaign, the occupation of Japan and the Korean War, ending in his clash with President Truman and his dismissal.

r-if-1968.plot: At a rigid English boarding school ruled by tradition and bullying senior boys, three rebellious students, led by Mick Travis, resist punishment and humiliation. Their quiet defiance gradually escalates from dreams and small acts into a violent, surreal uprising against the establishment.

r-straw-dogs-1971.plot: A mild American mathematician moves with his English wife to her home village in Cornwall. Tensions with local men hired to work on their farmhouse escalate from taunts to assault, building to a siege in which he must defend his home.

r-jesus-christ-superstar-1973.plot: A troupe of performers arrives in the desert to stage the final week of Jesus's life as a rock opera. Told largely through Judas's doubts, it follows the growing tension around Jesus, the authorities' fears and the path toward the crucifixion.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-hester-street-1975.plot: A Jewish immigrant in New York's Lower East Side eagerly embraces American ways and takes up with a modern dancer. When his devout wife and son arrive from the old country, her traditional habits clash with his new life and the marriage strains.
r-hester-street-1975.source: Yekl: A Tale of the New York Ghetto

setting.place: Lower East Side, New York City

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Carol Kane

r-anastasia-1956.plot: In 1920s Paris, a scheming general grooms an amnesiac, suicidal woman to pose as the surviving Grand Duchess Anastasia to claim a fortune. As she grows into the role, even he begins to wonder whether she is the real princess.

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Ingrid Bergman

r-bullitt-1968.plot: A cool San Francisco police lieutenant is assigned to protect a mob witness for an ambitious politician. When the witness is shot under his watch, he hides the facts, tracks the killers through the city and a legendary car chase, and uncovers that the case is not what it seemed.

r-to-live-and-die-in-l-a-1985.plot: A reckless Secret Service agent vows to bring down the slick counterfeiter who killed his partner. His obsession leads him to break every rule as he and his new partner sink deeper into moral murk.
r-to-live-and-die-in-l-a-1985.source: To Live and Die in L.A.

r-sweet-charity-1969.plot: A big-hearted, eternally hopeful taxi dancer at a seedy New York dance hall keeps falling for the wrong men. After a strange night with a movie star, she meets a shy, nervous insurance clerk and believes she may finally have found real love.

r-romancing-the-stone-1984.plot: A timid New York romance novelist flies to Colombia to ransom her kidnapped sister with a treasure map. Teaming up with a roguish adventurer, she races through the jungle ahead of crooks and soldiers.

r-the-mummy-1999.plot: In 1926, an adventurer, a bookish librarian and her brother lead an expedition to a lost Egyptian city. They accidentally awaken a cursed high priest who seeks to regain his full power and resurrect his lost love.

r-blade-runner-2049-2017.plot: Thirty years after the original film, a replicant blade runner in Los Angeles uncovers a long-buried secret that could upend society. His investigation leads him to track down Rick Deckard, a former blade runner missing for decades.

setting.place: Los Angeles; San Diego; Las Vegas

r-ghost-in-the-shell-1995.plot: In a future where people can augment themselves with cybernetic bodies, a cyborg officer of a security unit hunts a mysterious hacker able to hijack minds, while questioning her own identity.

r-ex-machina-2014.plot: A young programmer wins a week at the remote estate of his company's reclusive CEO. There he is asked to test whether a humanoid robot truly possesses consciousness, and he gradually realizes he may be the one being tested.

r-close-encounters-of-the-third-kind-197.plot: After a close encounter with a UFO on an Indiana road, a power-line worker becomes obsessed with a mysterious mountain shape he cannot stop envisioning. Meanwhile, international scientists prepare in secret for contact with visitors from space.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Melinda Dillon

r-the-goonies-1985.plot: Facing the loss of their homes to developers, a gang of kids in a coastal Oregon town find an old treasure map. They follow it underground into booby-trapped caverns, pursued by a family of crooks.

r-super-8-2011.plot: In 1979, a group of kids shooting a zombie movie on Super 8 film witness a spectacular train crash in their small Ohio town. Soon people go missing, the military moves in, and something that escaped from the wreckage is loose.

r-malcolm-x-1992.plot: An epic portrait of Malcolm X, from his troubled youth and life as a hustler through his conversion in prison and rise in the Nation of Islam, to his later transformation and assassination.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Denzel Washington

r-cry-freedom-1987.plot: A liberal white South African newspaper editor befriends Black activist Steve Biko and comes to see apartheid's brutality firsthand. After Biko dies in police custody, the editor risks everything to get his story out.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Denzel Washington

r-mandela-long-walk-to-freedom-2013.plot: Nelson Mandela's journey unfolds from his rural childhood and early legal career to anti-apartheid activism and 27 years in prison. His marriage to Winnie strains under persecution, and his release leads to negotiations for a democratic South Africa.

r-salvador-1986.plot: A broke, hard-living American photojournalist drives to El Salvador with his buddy hoping for work. Amid death squads and civil war, he documents atrocities and tries to rescue the local woman he loves.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — James Woods

r-the-official-story-1985.plot: As Argentina's military dictatorship crumbles, a comfortable history teacher begins to suspect that her adopted daughter may have been taken from a political prisoner. Her search for the truth upends her marriage and beliefs.

r-no-2012.plot: In 1988 Chile, under international pressure, General Pinochet calls a referendum on his rule. A young advertising executive is recruited by the opposition and designs a bright, upbeat TV campaign for the "No" vote, despite scorn and surveillance.

r-the-hateful-eight-2015.plot: In post-Civil War Wyoming, a blizzard strands a bounty hunter and his prisoner in a stagecoach lodge with a group of suspicious strangers. As tensions rise, it becomes clear that not everyone is who they claim to be.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Jennifer Jason Leigh

r-annihilation-2018.plot: A biologist joins an all-female expedition into the Shimmer, a spreading zone where nature has mutated in strange ways. She hopes to learn what happened to her husband, the lone survivor of a previous mission.

r-the-rainmaker-1997.plot: A newly graduated Memphis lawyer with no clients teams up with a scrappy paralegal to sue a giant insurance company that denied a dying young man's claim. He finds himself facing a powerful corporate legal team in court.

r-a-civil-action-1998.plot: A slick personal-injury lawyer takes on a case for Massachusetts families whose children died of leukemia, allegedly from contaminated groundwater. Facing two corporate giants, his crusade drains his firm's money and tests his principles.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Robert Duvall

r-absence-of-malice-1981.plot: A Miami reporter publishes a story, based on a deliberately leaked file, suggesting a liquor wholesaler is under investigation for a union leader's disappearance. As the article ruins his life and harms a vulnerable friend, he devises a clever counterattack.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Paul Newman
Actress in a Supporting Role — Melinda Dillon

r-the-birdcage-1996.plot: A gay cabaret owner in Miami and his flamboyant partner pretend to be a straight, traditional family when their son's fiancée brings her ultra-conservative senator father to dinner.

r-the-untouchables-1987.plot: In Prohibition-era Chicago, federal agent Eliot Ness assembles a small team of incorruptible lawmen, guided by a veteran Irish beat cop, to bring down Al Capone.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Sean Connery

r-blow-2001.plot: The rise and fall of George Jung, a Massachusetts kid who goes from selling marijuana in California to becoming a key American importer for the Medellín cocaine cartel. Wealth brings ruin to his marriage and his relationship with his daughter.

r-star-wars-the-force-awakens-2015.plot: Three decades after the Empire's fall, a scavenger on a desert planet and a defecting stormtrooper become caught up in the Resistance's fight against the First Order. Their search for a missing Luke Skywalker brings them together with legends of the past.

setting.period: A long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away

r-the-apostle-1997.plot: A charismatic Texas Pentecostal preacher loses his wife and church, and in a fit of rage commits a violent act. He flees to a small Louisiana town, renames himself, and starts a new congregation while trying to make peace with God.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Robert Duvall

r-paris-texas-1984.plot: A silent, disheveled man wanders out of the Texas desert after four years missing. Reunited with his brother and the young son he abandoned, he sets off to find the boy's mother.

r-beaches-1988.plot: Two girls from very different backgrounds meet as children on an Atlantic City beach and become lifelong pen pals and friends. Over three decades their bond survives rivalry, career ups and downs, and serious illness.

r-postcards-from-the-edge-1990.plot: A Hollywood actress fresh out of rehab can only get insured for her next film if she lives with her mother, a flamboyant former star. Their competitive, loving relationship becomes the real drama of her recovery.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Meryl Streep

r-the-return-of-the-secaucus-7-1979.plot: A group of former 1960s college activists, now around thirty, gathers for a summer weekend reunion at a friend's house in New Hampshire. Over conversations, basketball, swimming and a night in jail, they take stock of their relationships and what became of their ideals.

r-peter-s-friends-1992.plot: Ten years after graduating from Cambridge, a group of friends reunites for New Year's weekend at the country house one of them has inherited. Old affections, resentments and secrets resurface.

r-topsy-turvy-1999.plot: After a disappointing flop, the partnership of Gilbert and Sullivan is on the verge of collapse. A visit to a Japanese exhibition in London sparks the idea for The Mikado, and the film follows its painstaking creation and staging.

r-being-julia-2004.plot: A celebrated but weary London stage actress in the late 1930s embarks on an affair with a much younger American admirer. When he betrays her for an ambitious young actress, she plots a theatrical revenge.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Annette Bening

r-first-man-2018.plot: Neil Armstrong endures personal loss and deadly test flights through NASA's push to reach the Moon. The film follows the years leading to Apollo 11 and the toll the mission took on him and his family.
r-first-man-2018.source: First Man: The Life of Neil A. Armstrong

r-october-sky-1999.plot: In a West Virginia coal town, a teenager inspired by the launch of Sputnik starts building rockets with his friends. Despite his miner father's opposition, the boys aim for the national science fair and a way out of the mines.

r-space-cowboys-2000.plot: Decades after being passed over for space flight, a retired Air Force test pilot is asked to repair an old Soviet satellite whose guidance system he designed. He insists on bringing his aging former teammates, and the mission proves more dangerous than NASA admits.

r-heat-and-dust-1983.plot: A modern Englishwoman travels to India to retrace the steps of her great-aunt, who scandalized colonial society in the 1920s through her entanglement with a charming local prince. The two women's stories unfold in parallel.

r-maurice-1987.plot: At Cambridge, a conventional young Englishman falls in love with a fellow student. When his friend retreats into a respectable marriage, Maurice struggles with his identity in a society that criminalizes it, until an unexpected connection appears.

r-glory-1989.plot: During the American Civil War, a young Union officer takes command of one of the first all-Black regiments. Facing prejudice from their own side, the men train and fight to prove themselves in battle.
r-glory-1989.source: One Gallant Rush; Lay This Laurel

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Denzel Washington

r-courage-under-fire-1996.plot: An army officer haunted by a friendly-fire incident in the Gulf War is assigned to review a helicopter pilot's nomination for the Medal of Honor. The surviving crew's conflicting accounts suggest something is being hidden.

r-da-5-bloods-2020.plot: Four African American Vietnam veterans return to Vietnam to find the remains of their fallen squad leader and a buried stash of gold. Old wounds, greed and the country's history test their bonds.

setting.place: Ho Chi Minh City and jungle, Vietnam

r-immortal-beloved-1994.plot: After Beethoven's death, his secretary sets out to identify the mysterious woman named in a passionate unsent letter, the composer's sole heir. His search reveals the turbulent story of Beethoven's life.

r-copying-beethoven-2006.plot: In 1824 Vienna, a young music student is hired to copy the score of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony for its premiere. The deaf, volatile composer comes to rely on her, and an intense creative partnership develops between them.

r-country-1984.plot: An Iowa farm family faces foreclosure when a government lending agency calls in its debts during hard times. As the husband buckles under the strain, his wife leads the fight to keep their land.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Jessica Lange

r-the-river-1984.plot: A Tennessee farming family battles floods, falling prices and a powerful local businessman who wants their land flooded for a dam. Money troubles force the husband to take work as a strikebreaker.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Sissy Spacek

r-nobody-s-fool-1994.plot: A charming, irresponsible sixty-year-old handyman in a small upstate New York town gets a chance to reconnect with his estranged son and grandson over one winter, while feuding with his boss and flirting with the boss's wife.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Paul Newman

r-the-year-of-living-dangerously-1982.plot: An inexperienced Australian radio correspondent arrives in Jakarta as Sukarno's regime teeters. Guided by a well-connected photographer, he chases big stories and romances a British embassy officer as the country edges toward violent upheaval.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Linda Hunt

r-first-they-killed-my-father-2017.plot: Told through the eyes of five-year-old Loung Ung, the film follows her family's expulsion from Phnom Penh when the Khmer Rouge seizes power. Separated and forced into labor camps and child-soldier training, she struggles to survive the regime.
r-first-they-killed-my-father-2017.source: First They Killed My Father (Loung Ung)

r-robocop-1987.plot: In a crime-ridden near-future Detroit run by a corporation, a murdered police officer is rebuilt as a cyborg enforcer. As fragments of his memories return, he hunts his killers and uncovers corporate corruption.

r-predator-1987.plot: An elite commando team on a rescue mission in a Central American jungle discovers they are being stalked by an invisible alien hunter that collects trophies. Their weapons prove nearly useless as they are picked off.

r-looper-2012.plot: In 2044, a mob hitman kills targets sent back in time from 2074. When his next victim turns out to be his own older self, the man escapes, setting off a chase involving a farm, a single mother and her unusual young son.

r-back-to-the-future-part-ii-1989.plot: Marty McFly and Doc Brown travel to 2015 to fix a problem with Marty's future children. When old Biff steals the time machine to change history, they must return to 1955 to set things right.

r-ghostbusters-1984.plot: Three parapsychologists kicked out of their university start a ghost-removal business in New York. Business booms as supernatural activity surges, pointing to an ancient force preparing to break through at a Central Park West apartment.

r-ivan-s-childhood-1962.plot: During World War II, a 12-year-old boy whose family was killed by the Germans works as a scout for the Soviet army, slipping across enemy lines. The officers who care for him want to send him to safety, but he is consumed by the war and his memories of the life he lost.

r-the-ascent-1977.plot: During World War II, two Soviet partisans leave their starving unit in the Belarusian winter to find food. Captured by the Germans and their local collaborators, the men are interrogated and each faces a profound moral choice between survival and conscience.

r-the-cranes-are-flying-1957.plot: In Moscow on the eve of war, Veronika and Boris are in love, but he volunteers for the front. Alone and grief-stricken during the bombings, she makes a choice she regrets while hoping he will return.

r-pixote-1980.plot: A young boy in São Paulo is swept into a brutal reform school where abuse and corruption are routine. After escaping with other boys, he drifts into drug dealing, pimping and violence on the streets of São Paulo and Rio.

setting.place: São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
