r-before-night-falls-2000.plot: The life of Cuban poet and novelist Reinaldo Arenas, from a poor rural childhood to early support for the revolution. Persecuted as a gay writer under Castro, he is imprisoned and eventually leaves for exile in New York.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Javier Bardem

r-indochine-1992.plot: A French plantation owner in colonial Indochina raises an adopted Vietnamese princess. A love affair with the same naval officer divides them as the colony moves toward revolution.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Catherine Deneuve

r-the-constant-gardener-2005.plot: After his activist wife is murdered in northern Kenya, a mild-mannered British diplomat sets out to discover why. His investigation uncovers a conspiracy involving a pharmaceutical company testing drugs on poor Africans, and official efforts to bury it.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Rachel Weisz

r-married-to-the-mob-1988.plot: After her mobster husband is killed by his boss, a widow tries to start a new life with her son in Manhattan. The amorous boss pursues her, his jealous wife pursues him, and an FBI agent goes undercover to watch her.

setting.place: Long Island and New York City

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Dean Stockwell

r-the-war-of-the-roses-1989.plot: A divorce lawyer recounts the story of a seemingly perfect couple whose marriage sours. Neither will give up their lavish house, and the split escalates into an all-out war.

r-mr-mrs-smith-2005.plot: A bored suburban married couple each hide a secret: both are elite assassins working for rival agencies. When they are assigned to eliminate each other, their marriage turns into an all-out war.

r-beloved-1998.plot: Years after escaping slavery, a woman lives in an Ohio house haunted by the spirit of her dead baby. When a mysterious young woman called Beloved appears, she brings back memories of a terrible act the mother committed.

r-fried-green-tomatoes-1991.plot: An unhappy Alabama housewife befriends an elderly woman in a nursing home who tells her about two women who ran a café in a Depression-era railroad town. The tale of their loyal friendship inspires her to change her own life.
r-fried-green-tomatoes-1991.source: Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Stop Cafe

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Jessica Tandy

r-the-color-purple-2023.plot: Separated from her beloved sister and married to an abusive husband in rural Georgia, Celie endures decades of hardship. Helped by remarkable women, she gradually finds her voice and self-worth in this musical retelling.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Danielle Brooks

r-cop-land-1997.plot: A partially deaf sheriff of a New Jersey town populated by New York City police officers is ignored by the cops who live there. When a cover-up surrounding a shooting unfolds, he must decide whether to stand up to them.

setting.place: Garrison, New Jersey; New York City

r-frantic-1988.plot: An American surgeon in Paris for a conference finds his wife has vanished from their hotel room. Getting nowhere with the authorities, he searches the city himself and stumbles into an international smuggling plot.

r-enchanted-april-1991.plot: Four very different Englishwomen, weary of dreary London and their lives, pool their money to rent a castle on the Italian Riviera for a month. The sunlit setting gently transforms each of them.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Joan Plowright

r-starship-troopers-1997.plot: In a militaristic future society, a group of young recruits join the armed forces just as Earth goes to war with giant alien insects. Gung-ho propaganda and gory battles on distant planets combine in a satire of fascist spectacle.

r-edge-of-tomorrow-2014.plot: During an alien invasion, an inexperienced officer is thrown into a doomed beach assault and killed, only to wake up again the previous day. Trapped in a time loop, he trains with a legendary soldier to learn how to defeat the enemy.

r-beyond-silence-1996.plot: The hearing daughter of deaf parents has long been their interpreter to the outside world. When she discovers a talent for the clarinet and moves toward a music career, the family struggles with her independence.

r-the-royal-tenenbaums-2001.plot: Three former child prodigies, now adults burdened by failure and heartbreak, return to the family home. Their estranged, roguish father, learning his ex-wife may remarry, claims to be dying in a bid to win his way back into their lives.

r-hamburger-hill-1987.plot: A squad of young U.S. soldiers, many fresh replacements, fight through a brutal, repeated assault on a heavily fortified hill in Vietnam's A Shau Valley, losing men with every push.

r-we-were-soldiers-2002.plot: Lt. Col. Hal Moore leads a battalion of air cavalry troopers into one of the first major battles of the Vietnam War, where they are surrounded by a much larger North Vietnamese force. Back home, their wives await news of who will return.
r-we-were-soldiers-2002.source: We Were Soldiers Once... and Young

setting.place: Ia Drang Valley, Vietnam; Fort Benning, Georgia

r-the-sandlot-1993.plot: A shy new kid in a 1960s suburb joins a ragtag neighborhood baseball team. Their summer of games and adventures turns into a quest when a precious autographed ball goes over the fence into the yard of a feared dog.

r-mud-2012.plot: Two teenage boys in rural Arkansas find a boat stuck in a tree on a Mississippi River island, along with a fugitive named Mud who is hiding there. Drawn by his story of love, they help him evade bounty hunters and reunite with his girlfriend.

r-silence-2016.plot: In the 17th century, two Portuguese Jesuit priests travel to Japan, where Christianity is outlawed, to find their mentor, who is rumored to have renounced his faith. They witness the brutal persecution of hidden Christians and face their own crisis of faith.

r-the-paper-1994.plot: Over a hectic 24 hours, the metro editor of a New York tabloid races to get the true story of a double murder into print, while juggling a pregnant wife, a job offer and a combative boss.

r-basic-instinct-1992.plot: A San Francisco detective investigates the brutal murder of a rock star. The prime suspect is a seductive crime novelist whose book eerily mirrors the killing, and he is drawn into a dangerous game with her.

r-unfaithful-2002.plot: A suburban wife with a seemingly happy marriage begins a passionate affair with a charming young book dealer she meets by chance in Manhattan. As her husband grows suspicious and confronts the truth, a moment of rage pulls the family toward disaster.

setting.place: Westchester suburbs and SoHo, New York

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Diane Lane

r-play-misty-for-me-1971.plot: A late-night radio DJ in Carmel has a casual fling with a fan who keeps requesting the same jazz song. When he tries to move on, her attachment turns possessive and then violent, threatening his career and the woman he loves.

r-jarhead-2005.plot: A young Marine trained as a scout sniper is deployed to the Saudi desert in the lead-up to the Gulf War. He and his unit endure months of boredom, heat and frustration, waiting for a combat that never quite arrives as they imagined.

r-tigerland-2000.plot: In 1971, recruits at a Louisiana training camp prepare for the war in Vietnam. A rebellious, charismatic private who openly defies the army helps fellow soldiers get discharged, while facing the final phase of training in a swampy jungle replica.

r-radio-days-1987.plot: A narrator recalls growing up in a boisterous Jewish family in Rockaway, Queens, during the golden age of radio. Family anecdotes intertwine with the gossip and glamour of the era's radio stars.

r-only-you-1994.plot: A schoolteacher who believes since childhood that fate has named her soulmate impulsively flies to Italy days before her wedding to find a man with that name, and meets a charming stranger along the way.

setting.place: Pittsburgh; Venice, Rome and Positano, Italy

r-big-night-1996.plot: Two Italian immigrant brothers run a struggling restaurant on the New Jersey shore. Facing ruin, they stake everything on one lavish dinner they hope will be attended by a famous singer.

r-my-big-fat-greek-wedding-2002.plot: A shy thirty-year-old woman from a loud, tight-knit Greek-American family in Chicago falls in love with a gentle non-Greek schoolteacher. Planning their wedding means winning over her traditional father and surviving her relatives.
r-my-big-fat-greek-wedding-2002.source: My Big Fat Greek Wedding (one-woman show)

r-farewell-my-concubine-1993.plot: Two boys trained together in a brutal Peking opera school become stage stars. Their bond, and a woman who comes between them, is tested over half a century of war, revolution and political upheaval.

r-raise-the-red-lantern-1991.plot: A young university student becomes the fourth wife of a wealthy master in 1920s China. Inside his walled compound, the wives compete fiercely for his favor, marked each night by which house has its red lanterns lit.

setting.place: A family compound in northern China

r-malena-2000.plot: In a Sicilian town during World War II, a thirteen-year-old boy becomes infatuated with a beautiful woman whose husband is away at war. He secretly watches as the town's gossip, envy and cruelty slowly destroy her.

r-amarcord-1973.plot: Over the course of a year in a seaside Italian town under Fascism, a teenage boy and his boisterous family and neighbors live through festivals, school pranks, erotic fantasies and political absurdities in a series of nostalgic, comic and melancholy episodes.

setting.place: Seaside town in Romagna, Italy (modeled on Rimini)

r-the-legend-of-1900-1998.plot: A baby abandoned on an ocean liner in 1900 grows up aboard and becomes a dazzling pianist who never sets foot on land. A trumpet player and friend recalls his story, including a famous piano duel and a love that tempts him ashore.

setting.place: An ocean liner crossing the Atlantic

r-valmont-1989.plot: In pre-revolutionary France, a scheming marquise and her former lover, the seductive Vicomte de Valmont, play cruel games of seduction with the reputations of innocent young people, until their own feelings get in the way.

r-cruel-intentions-1999.plot: Two wealthy, manipulative Manhattan step-siblings make a wager: he must seduce the virtuous daughter of their prep school's new headmaster. The game turns complicated when he begins to fall for her.

r-ridicule-1996.plot: A provincial nobleman travels to Versailles to seek the king's support for draining his region's disease-ridden swamps. To get access, he must survive a court where barbed wit is power and ridicule can destroy.

r-lethal-weapon-1987.plot: A cautious veteran LAPD detective nearing retirement is partnered with a suicidal, unpredictable ex-Special Forces cop. Investigating a young woman's death, they uncover a drug-smuggling ring run by former mercenaries.

r-speed-1994.plot: A Los Angeles SWAT cop must save the passengers on a city bus rigged by a vengeful bomber to explode if its speed drops below 50 mph, with a passenger forced to take the wheel.

r-in-this-corner-of-the-world-2016.plot: A dreamy young woman from Hiroshima marries and moves to the naval port city of Kure in the 1940s. She tries to keep everyday life going for her new family as World War II brings shortages, air raids and loss.
r-in-this-corner-of-the-world-2016.source: In This Corner of the World

r-barefoot-gen-1983.plot: A young boy and his family struggle through wartime hunger in Hiroshima until the atomic bomb destroys the city. Gen tries to survive and care for those left in the devastated aftermath.

r-the-wind-rises-2013.plot: A fictionalized portrait of Jiro Horikoshi, the Japanese engineer who dreamed of building beautiful aircraft and went on to design fighter planes used in World War II. His passion for flight unfolds alongside earthquake, depression, war and a tender love story.

r-ghosts-of-mississippi-1996.plot: Decades after civil rights leader Medgar Evers was murdered, an assistant district attorney and Evers's widow push to retry the white supremacist who killed him, despite threats and resistance.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — James Woods

r-a-time-to-kill-1996.plot: After a Black father in Mississippi kills the men who assaulted his young daughter, a young white lawyer takes his case. The trial inflames racial tensions and draws the Ku Klux Klan into town.

r-kiki-s-delivery-service-1989.plot: Following tradition, a 13-year-old witch leaves home with her talking cat to spend a year in a new town. She starts a flying delivery business in a seaside city, but self-doubt begins to sap her powers.

r-the-secret-world-of-arrietty-2010.plot: Arrietty, a tiny teenage girl, lives secretly beneath the floorboards of a suburban house with her parents, borrowing small things to survive. When a sickly boy staying in the house spots her, their friendship endangers her family's hidden way of life.

r-wolf-children-2012.plot: A college student falls in love with a man who can turn into a wolf, and they have two children who share his gift. After he dies, she raises the kids alone and moves to the countryside, where each child must choose between human and wolf.

r-what-s-eating-gilbert-grape-1993.plot: In a stagnant small Iowa town, a young grocery clerk cares for his intellectually disabled younger brother and his housebound mother. The arrival of a free-spirited traveler makes him wonder about a life of his own.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Leonardo DiCaprio

r-planes-trains-and-automobiles-1987.plot: An uptight ad executive trying to get home to Chicago for Thanksgiving is stuck traveling with a loud, overly friendly shower-curtain-ring salesman. One mishap after another turns a short trip into a cross-country ordeal.

r-i-am-sam-2001.plot: A man with an intellectual disability raises his daughter alone with help from devoted friends. When she turns seven and begins to surpass him, social services take her away, and he enlists a high-powered lawyer to win her back.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Sean Penn

r-grand-canyon-1991.plot: When an immigration lawyer's car breaks down in a dangerous part of Los Angeles, a tow-truck driver comes to his aid. Their unlikely friendship anchors an ensemble portrait of people trying to cope with the city's chaos and violence.

r-shadowlands-1993.plot: The Oxford scholar and author C.S. Lewis, a confirmed bachelor, forms an unexpected friendship with a forthright American poet. Their relationship grows into love and challenges his ideas about faith and suffering.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Debra Winger

r-9-to-5-1980.plot: Three secretaries fed up with their sexist, lying boss fantasize about revenge. When a mix-up makes them think they have accidentally poisoned him, events spiral until they hold him captive at home and secretly run the office far better without him.

setting.place: Corporate office in a U.S. city

r-big-1988.plot: A 12-year-old makes a wish at a carnival machine to be big and wakes up in an adult's body. Hiding in New York, he lands a job at a toy company where his childlike outlook makes him a star.

setting.place: New Jersey and New York City

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Tom Hanks

r-the-devil-wears-prada-2006.plot: An aspiring journalist with no interest in fashion lands a job as junior assistant to the icy, all-powerful editor of a top New York fashion magazine. Meeting her impossible demands transforms her, but at a cost to her friends and her values.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Meryl Streep

r-thank-you-for-your-service-2017.plot: A group of U.S. soldiers return home from the Iraq War and struggle to reintegrate into family and civilian life. Battling PTSD and a bureaucratic VA, they fight to recover from the trauma they carry.
r-thank-you-for-your-service-2017.source: Thank You for Your Service (David Finkel)

r-brothers-2009.plot: When a Marine captain is reported killed in Afghanistan, his ex-con younger brother steps in to help his widow and daughters. But the captain is alive, and when he returns home traumatized by captivity, he suspects what grew between them.

r-in-the-valley-of-elah-2007.plot: A retired military policeman learns his son has gone missing shortly after returning from Iraq. Working with a local detective after the young man's body is found, he investigates the killing and uncovers troubling truths about his son's war experience.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Tommy Lee Jones

r-mona-lisa-smile-2003.plot: A free-thinking art history teacher from California joins the faculty of conservative Wellesley College in the 1950s. She challenges her bright students to imagine lives beyond marriage, stirring conflict with the school's establishment and the young women themselves.

r-the-emperor-s-club-2002.plot: A principled classics teacher at an elite boys' boarding school tries to shape the character of a defiant senator's son. Decades later, a reunion contest forces him to reckon with whether his lessons ever took hold.

setting.place: Boarding school in Virginia; Long Island

r-stand-and-deliver-1988.plot: A demanding math teacher at an East Los Angeles high school convinces underachieving students they can master calculus. When they ace the AP exam, the testing authorities suspect cheating.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Edward James Olmos

r-bull-durham-1988.plot: A veteran catcher is sent to a minor-league team in Durham to mentor a wild young pitcher with a great arm. A baseball-devoted woman who takes one player under her wing each season comes between them.

r-big-fish-2003.plot: A man estranged from his dying father returns home, frustrated by the tall tales the old storyteller has always told about his life. As the son digs for the truth, the father's fanciful adventures with giants, witches, and circus folk unfold on screen.
r-big-fish-2003.source: Big Fish: A Novel of Mythic Proportions

r-national-treasure-2004.plot: A historian from a family of treasure hunters believes a legendary hoard hidden by the Founding Fathers is real, and that a clue lies on the back of the Declaration of Independence. To beat a ruthless rival to it, he decides to steal the document himself.

setting.place: Washington, D.C.; Philadelphia; New York City; the Arctic

r-the-sea-inside-2004.plot: Left quadriplegic by a diving accident in his youth, Ramón Sampedro has spent decades in bed in his family's Galician home. He fights a long legal campaign for the right to end his life, forming deep bonds with the women who enter his world.

r-angela-s-ashes-1999.plot: Frank McCourt recalls a childhood of grinding poverty after his Irish family returns from Brooklyn to Limerick. With an alcoholic father and a struggling mother, young Frank endures hunger, illness and loss while dreaming of America.

r-lorenzo-s-oil-1992.plot: When their young son is diagnosed with a rare and fatal disease, a couple refuses to accept doctors' lack of answers. With no medical training, they throw themselves into research in search of a treatment.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Susan Sarandon

r-patch-adams-1998.plot: After a stay in a psychiatric ward, a man decides to become a doctor who treats patients with humor and compassion. His unconventional bedside antics in medical school put him at odds with the strict dean.
writers: Hunter Doherty Adams and Maureen Mylander (book)
r-patch-adams-1998.source: Gesundheit: Good Health Is a Laughing Matter

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-last-of-the-mohicans-1992.plot: During the French and Indian War, a frontiersman raised by Mohicans agrees to escort the daughters of a British colonel through dangerous territory, as the conflict between the empires and their allies closes in around them.

r-jeremiah-johnson-1972.plot: A former soldier leaves civilization to live as a trapper in the Rocky Mountains. He learns to survive harsh winters, gains an unexpected family, and becomes entangled in a long feud with the Crow after an act that violates their sacred ground.

r-truly-madly-deeply-1990.plot: A London translator overwhelmed by grief for her partner, a cellist, is stunned when he returns as a ghost. The joy of the reunion gradually gives way to the question of whether she can move on.

r-city-of-angels-1998.plot: An angel who silently watches over Los Angeles falls in love with a dedicated heart surgeon. To be with her and feel what humans feel, he considers giving up his immortality.

r-what-dreams-may-come-1998.plot: After dying in a car accident, a doctor finds himself in a vivid afterlife shaped like his wife's paintings. When he learns that she has taken her own life and been sent to hell, he sets out to rescue her.

r-donnie-brasco-1997.plot: An FBI agent goes undercover in the New York Mafia and is taken under the wing of a weary, low-level hitman. As he gets deeper inside, his loyalties blur and his family life suffers.
r-donnie-brasco-1997.source: Donnie Brasco: My Undercover Life in the Mafia

r-eastern-promises-2007.plot: A London midwife finds a Russian diary on a teenage girl who died in childbirth and tries to trace the baby's family. Her search leads her to a restaurant owned by a Russian mob boss and his enigmatic driver, a man with loyalties she cannot read.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Viggo Mortensen

r-the-little-mermaid-1989.plot: Ariel, a curious mermaid princess fascinated by the human world, falls for a prince she rescues. She strikes a deal with a sea witch, trading her voice for legs, and must win his love within three days.

r-aladdin-1992.plot: A street-smart thief in the desert city of Agrabah finds a magic lamp holding a wisecracking genie. Wishing to win the heart of a spirited princess, he must also outwit the sultan's scheming vizier.

r-tangled-2010.plot: Rapunzel, a princess with magical long hair, has spent her life locked in a tower by a woman she believes is her mother. When a charming thief takes refuge there, she strikes a deal for him to guide her to see the floating lanterns that appear on her birthday.

r-the-cotton-club-1984.plot: At Harlem's famed Cotton Club during Prohibition, a cornet player gets entangled with gangsters and a mobster's girlfriend, while a tap dancer pursues love and fame. Jazz, glamour and violence intertwine.

r-billy-bathgate-1991.plot: A streetwise Bronx teenager talks his way into the inner circle of gangster Dutch Schultz. As the mob empire begins to crumble, he learns the cost of the glamorous life and gets tangled up with the boss's mistress.

r-public-enemies-2009.plot: During the Depression, charismatic bank robber John Dillinger becomes a folk hero as he and his gang pull daring heists across the Midwest. Federal agent Melvin Purvis is tasked by J. Edgar Hoover with bringing him down.
r-public-enemies-2009.source: Public Enemies: America's Greatest Crime Wave and the Birth of the FBI, 1933-34

r-nixon-1995.plot: A sweeping portrait of Richard Nixon that moves between his hard upbringing, his political rise and falls, and his presidency, culminating in the Watergate scandal and his resignation.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Anthony Hopkins
Actress in a Supporting Role — Joan Allen

r-total-recall-1990.plot: A construction worker haunted by dreams of Mars buys an implanted vacation memory, only for the procedure to unlock what may be a hidden past as a secret agent. Soon he is on the run and heading to the red planet.
r-total-recall-1990.source: We Can Remember It for You Wholesale

r-manhunter-1986.plot: A retired FBI profiler with a gift for getting inside killers' heads is drawn back to hunt a serial murderer who slaughters families. To understand him, he consults the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor.

r-insomnia-2002.plot: Two Los Angeles detectives fly to a small Alaskan town to investigate a teenage girl's murder. In the endless daylight of summer, one detective, sleepless and guilty over a mistake, is drawn into a manipulative game with the killer.

r-the-go-between-1971.plot: A boy spending a hot summer at a schoolfriend's grand country house agrees to carry secret letters between the family's daughter and a local tenant farmer. Unaware of what he is part of, he is caught in a forbidden affair that marks him for life.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Margaret Leighton

r-the-wings-of-the-dove-1997.plot: In Edwardian London, a woman who cannot marry the poor journalist she loves devises a scheme involving a dying American heiress. The three travel to Venice, where the plan grows more painful and morally tangled than any of them expected.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Helena Bonham Carter

r-the-killing-1956.plot: A career criminal recruits a crew of ordinary men to rob a racetrack's cash room during a big race. The meticulous plan, shown from shifting viewpoints and timelines, begins to unravel through human weakness.

r-city-on-fire-1987.plot: A weary undercover Hong Kong cop infiltrates a gang of jewel robbers and grows close to one of them. Squeezed between his superiors and the criminals, he struggles with divided loyalties as a heist approaches.

r-jackie-brown-1997.plot: A middle-aged flight attendant caught smuggling cash for a gun dealer is squeezed by federal agents. With help from a weary bail bondsman, she plays the dealer and the law against each other to walk away with half a million dollars.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Robert Forster

r-midnight-run-1988.plot: A bounty hunter must bring a mob accountant who skipped bail from New York to Los Angeles within days. The FBI, the Mafia and a rival bounty hunter chase them across the country as the bickering pair warm to each other.

r-finding-forrester-2000.plot: A gifted Black teenager from the Bronx, secretly a talented writer, befriends a reclusive novelist who published one celebrated book decades ago. As he moves to an elite prep school, the two help each other in unexpected ways.

r-st-vincent-2014.plot: A single mother moves to Brooklyn with her young son and leaves him in the care of their neighbor, a hard-drinking, gambling Vietnam veteran. The unlikely friendship between the grouch and the boy reveals more to the old man than anyone expected.

r-open-range-2003.plot: Two veteran free-grazing cowboys driving cattle across the open range run afoul of a ruthless rancher who controls a frontier town. After their crew is attacked, they must decide whether to move on or make a stand.

r-bloody-sunday-2002.plot: A docudrama recreation of 30 January 1972 in Derry, Northern Ireland, when British paratroopers opened fire on a civil rights march. It follows a march organizer, protesters and soldiers in the hours before and after the shootings.

r-the-hurricane-1999.plot: Middleweight boxer Rubin 'Hurricane' Carter is wrongfully convicted of a triple murder and spends nearly two decades in prison. A Brooklyn teenager who reads his autobiography, and a group of Canadian activists, fight to free him.
r-the-hurricane-1999.source: The Sixteenth Round; Lazarus and the Hurricane

setting.place: Paterson, New Jersey; Trenton State Prison; Toronto

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Denzel Washington

r-king-kong-2005.plot: In Depression-era New York, a desperate filmmaker takes his crew and a struggling actress to a mysterious island to shoot his picture. There they encounter prehistoric creatures and a giant gorilla who forms a bond with the actress, before being captured and brought to Manhattan.

r-tremors-1990.plot: Two handymen in a tiny Nevada desert town discover that giant carnivorous creatures are moving underground. Cut off from help, the residents must outwit the beasts that hunt by sensing vibrations.

r-twister-1996.plot: A team of storm chasers in Oklahoma tries to deploy a sensor device inside a tornado during a record outbreak. Its leader's estranged husband rejoins the crew as a well-funded rival team competes with them.

r-son-of-saul-2015.plot: In 1944, a Hungarian Jewish prisoner forced to work in an Auschwitz Sonderkommando believes he recognizes the body of his son. Over a day and a half, he risks everything to find a rabbi and give the boy a proper burial amid the camp's horrors.

r-europa-europa-1990.plot: A Jewish teenager fleeing Nazi persecution survives by hiding his identity, first in a Soviet orphanage and then, improbably, as a model pupil in an elite Hitler Youth school, living in constant fear that his secret will be discovered.

r-u-s-marshals-1998.plot: When a prison transport plane crashes, a prisoner accused of killing two federal agents escapes. Deputy Marshal Sam Gerard and his team chase him across the country, while a suspicious government agent joins the pursuit.

r-enemy-of-the-state-1998.plot: A Washington lawyer unknowingly receives evidence of a politically motivated murder committed by a rogue NSA official. Hunted by high-tech surveillance and framed, he turns to a paranoid ex-agent to survive.

r-the-bourne-identity-2002.plot: Fishermen pull a man with bullet wounds and no memory out of the Mediterranean. Armed with uncanny combat skills and a Swiss bank account number, he enlists a stranger's help to uncover his identity while a covert CIA program sends assassins after him across Europe.

r-portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire-2019.plot: In 18th-century Brittany, a painter is hired to secretly paint the portrait of a reluctant bride-to-be on a remote island. Observing her subject by day, she and the young woman fall into an intense, forbidden romance.

r-lady-macbeth-2016.plot: In 1865 rural England, a young woman sold into a loveless marriage with an older man is confined to his family's estate. When she begins a passionate affair with a stable hand, she becomes ruthless in pursuit of what she wants.
r-lady-macbeth-2016.source: Lady Macbeth of the Mtsensk District

r-never-let-me-go-2010.plot: Three friends grow up at Hailsham, a seemingly idyllic English boarding school whose students are told they are special. As adults, they confront the purpose they were raised for, while a love triangle shapes their limited time.

r-cast-away-2000.plot: A time-obsessed FedEx systems engineer survives a plane crash and washes up alone on an uninhabited Pacific island. Over years of isolation he learns to survive, talking to a volleyball for company, while longing for the woman he left behind.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Tom Hanks

r-love-actually-2003.plot: In the five weeks before Christmas, a loosely connected group of Londoners, from a new prime minister to a grieving widower and an aging rock star, stumble through love, longing and heartbreak. Their stories overlap and converge as the holiday arrives.

r-bridget-jones-s-diary-2001.plot: A single, thirty-something Londoner starts a diary resolving to improve her life, quit bad habits and find love. She is torn between her charming but caddish boss and a stiff, disapproving lawyer she keeps running into.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Renée Zellweger

r-la-femme-nikita-1990.plot: A violent young junkie sentenced to death is secretly recruited by a government agency, which fakes her execution and trains her as an assassin. Trying to build a normal life and a romance, she finds the job will not let her go.

r-man-on-fire-2004.plot: A burned-out former CIA operative takes a job as bodyguard to a young girl in kidnapping-plagued Mexico City. As she breaks through his despair, she is abducted, and he unleashes a brutal campaign of revenge against everyone involved.

r-ghost-dog-the-way-of-the-samurai-1999.plot: A solitary hitman who lives by the code of the samurai serves a low-level mobster who once saved his life. When a job goes wrong and the mob turns on him, he answers according to his code, communicating by carrier pigeon.

setting.place: An unnamed city in New Jersey

r-true-romance-1993.plot: A comic-book clerk in Detroit falls for a call girl and marries her. After he impulsively takes a suitcase of cocaine from her pimp, the newlyweds flee to Los Angeles to sell it, with mobsters and police on their trail.

r-in-bruges-2008.plot: After a job goes badly wrong, two Irish hitmen are ordered to lie low in the medieval Belgian city of Bruges. The older one enjoys the sightseeing while his guilt-ridden young partner hates every minute, until their volatile boss calls with new instructions.

r-shattered-glass-2003.plot: Stephen Glass is a charming young star writer at The New Republic in the late 1990s. When a rival online reporter cannot verify any details of one of his stories, his new editor begins to suspect that much of Glass's work has been fabricated.

r-the-jungle-book-1967.plot: Mowgli, a boy raised by wolves in the Indian jungle, must leave for the human village when the man-eating tiger Shere Khan returns. A protective panther escorts him, but along the way he befriends a fun-loving bear and meets a scheming python and a jazz-loving orangutan king.

r-bambi-1942.plot: A young fawn, born as the forest's future prince, grows up learning about the world with his friends Thumper the rabbit and Flower the skunk. Through changing seasons he faces wonder, love and the danger posed by hunters.
r-bambi-1942.source: Bambi, a Life in the Woods

r-sully-2016.plot: After pilot Chesley Sullenberger lands a disabled airliner on the Hudson River and saves all aboard, he is hailed as a hero. Meanwhile, an investigation questions whether his split-second decision was the right one.

r-thirteen-days-2000.plot: During the Cuban Missile Crisis of October 1962, President Kennedy, his brother Robert and aide Kenneth O'Donnell struggle to avoid nuclear war. They resist pressure from the military while negotiating with the Soviet Union.
writers: Ernest R. May and Philip Zelikow (book)

r-babe-pig-in-the-city-1998.plot: After an accident leaves Farmer Hoggett unable to work and the farm in debt, Babe the pig and Mrs. Hoggett travel to a sprawling city to earn money. Stranded in a hotel full of animals, Babe has to rescue his new friends.

setting.place: Hoggett farm; the fictional city of Metropolis

r-charlotte-s-web-2006.plot: A runt piglet saved by a farm girl is sent to her uncle's barn, where he learns he is destined for the dinner table. A wise spider named Charlotte befriends him and devises a plan to save his life by weaving words into her web.

r-chicken-run-2000.plot: Hens on a grim Yorkshire egg farm keep failing to escape. When a cocky American rooster crash-lands among them, their determined leader believes he can teach them to fly, just as the farm's owner plans to turn them all into pies.

r-before-midnight-2013.plot: Nearly two decades after first meeting, Jesse and Céline are now a couple with twin daughters, ending a summer holiday in Greece. Over long conversations and one tense night, buried frustrations about family, career and commitment come to the surface.

r-once-2007.plot: A Dublin street busker who repairs vacuum cleaners meets a Czech immigrant pianist who sells flowers. Over a few weeks they write and record songs together, forming a tender connection complicated by their other relationships.

r-weekend-2011.plot: After a Friday night at a gay club, a reserved lifeguard brings home an outspoken art student. What begins as a one-night stand becomes an intense weekend of conversation and intimacy, with a deadline looming over them.

r-rob-roy-1995.plot: In the Scottish Highlands, clan leader Rob Roy MacGregor borrows money from a nobleman to improve his people's lot. When the money is stolen, he is pursued by a cruel aristocrat and fights to defend his honor and family.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Tim Roth

r-boogie-nights-1997.plot: A teenage busboy in the San Fernando Valley is discovered by a porn director and becomes a star. The film follows him and his makeshift family of performers from the industry's heyday into the excesses of the 1980s.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Burt Reynolds
Actress in a Supporting Role — Julianne Moore

r-collateral-2004.plot: A quiet Los Angeles cab driver picks up a well-dressed fare who pays him to drive between several stops through the night. He soon realizes his passenger is a contract killer, and that he is now a hostage in the hit man's plan.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jamie Foxx

r-thief-1981.plot: A meticulous professional safecracker in Chicago wants one last big score so he can buy into a normal family life. Taking a job from a powerful mobster, he finds the deal costs far more freedom than he bargained for.

r-the-town-2010.plot: The leader of a crew of Boston bank robbers from Charlestown grows close to a bank manager they briefly took hostage, while she remains unaware of who he is. As the FBI closes in, he wants out, but his violent best friend and their boss have other plans.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jeremy Renner

r-do-the-right-thing-1989.plot: On the hottest day of the summer in a Brooklyn neighborhood, a delivery man for an Italian-American pizzeria moves among the block's residents. Small grievances and racial tensions build through the day toward an explosion.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Danny Aiello

r-les-miserables-2019.plot: A new officer joins an anti-crime squad patrolling Montfermeil, a tense Paris suburb. When an arrest goes wrong and is caught on a drone's camera, the police and local factions spiral toward explosive conflict.

r-boyz-n-the-hood-1991.plot: Sent to live with his principled father in South Central Los Angeles, a boy grows up alongside friends facing gangs, violence and limited options. As young men, they must decide which paths they will take.

r-emma-2020.plot: Handsome, clever and rich, Emma Woodhouse amuses herself by matchmaking among her neighbors in a small English village. Her meddling causes misunderstandings and heartache, including in her own unrecognized feelings.

r-persuasion-1995.plot: Eight years after being persuaded to reject a penniless naval officer, a quiet woman from a declining aristocratic family meets him again, now a wealthy captain, and must face her lingering feelings.

r-cure-1997.plot: A Tokyo detective investigates a series of murders in which each killer is found near the victim with no memory of why they did it. The cases lead to a strange amnesiac young man.

r-neruda-2016.plot: In 1948, poet and senator Pablo Neruda is forced into hiding after the Chilean government outlaws communism. A vain police inspector pursues him across the country in a cat-and-mouse chase that is part history, part invention.

r-the-game-1997.plot: A cold, wealthy San Francisco banker receives an unusual birthday gift from his estranged brother: entry into a mysterious live-action game. Soon the game seeps into every part of his life, and he cannot tell where it ends and real danger begins.

r-toy-story-2-1999.plot: When cowboy doll Woody is stolen by a greedy toy collector, he learns he was once the star of a popular TV show and is offered a place in a museum. Buzz Lightyear and the other toys set out across town to bring him home.

r-the-lego-movie-2014.plot: An ordinary Lego construction worker is mistaken for the prophesied hero who can stop a tyrant from gluing the whole Lego world into permanent order. He joins a band of master builders on a wildly inventive quest.

r-shrek-2001.plot: A grumpy ogre finds his swamp overrun by exiled fairy-tale creatures. To get it back, he strikes a deal with a petty lord to rescue a princess from a dragon-guarded tower, accompanied by a talkative donkey.

r-a-simple-plan-1998.plot: Two brothers and a friend stumble on a crashed plane in the snowy woods containing millions in cash. Deciding to keep the money quietly, they are soon dragged into paranoia, lies and violence as their plan unravels.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Billy Bob Thornton

r-wind-river-2017.plot: A wildlife tracker finds a young Native American woman's body frozen in the snow on a Wyoming reservation. He teams with an inexperienced FBI agent to uncover what happened, confronting his own grief along the way.

r-shallow-grave-1994.plot: Three smug Edinburgh flatmates find their new lodger dead with a suitcase full of cash. They decide to dispose of the body and keep the money, a choice that turns them against each other.

r-almost-famous-2000.plot: In 1973, a fifteen-year-old aspiring music journalist lands an assignment from Rolling Stone to tour with an up-and-coming rock band. On the road he falls for a free-spirited fan and struggles to stay honest about the people he admires.

setting.place: San Diego; on tour across the US; New York

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Kate Hudson
Actress in a Supporting Role — Frances McDormand

r-tin-cup-1996.plot: A talented but self-sabotaging golf pro running a rundown Texas driving range tries to qualify for the US Open, partly to impress the girlfriend of his more successful rival.

r-vera-drake-2004.plot: In 1950 London, a warm-hearted housekeeper devoted to her working-class family secretly helps young women end unwanted pregnancies. When one of them falls seriously ill, the police uncover her activities and her family's world is shattered.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Imelda Staunton

r-another-year-2010.plot: Over the four seasons of one year, a contented, long-married London couple tend their allotment and host friends and family. Their happiness contrasts with the loneliness of those around them, especially a lonely, chattering colleague who leans on them.

r-shoplifters-2018.plot: A poor Tokyo family scrapes by on odd jobs and petty theft. After taking in a neglected little girl they find in the cold, their makeshift household grows closer, until hidden truths about who they are come to light.

r-hilary-and-jackie-1998.plot: The story of cellist Jacqueline du Pré and her sister Hilary, a flautist, told from each sister's perspective. As Jackie rises to international fame, their bond is strained by jealousy and later by her devastating illness.
writers: Hilary du Pré and Piers du Pré (memoir)

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Emily Watson
Actress in a Supporting Role — Rachel Griffiths

r-the-soloist-2009.plot: A Los Angeles Times columnist meets a homeless, schizophrenic man playing a two-string violin on the street and learns he once studied at Juilliard. Writing about him, the journalist tries to help, forming an unlikely and complicated friendship.

r-the-end-of-the-affair-1999.plot: In London after World War II, a novelist runs into the husband of the woman with whom he had a passionate wartime affair. Still bitter at how she abruptly ended it, he hires a private detective to discover the truth.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Julianne Moore

r-t2-trainspotting-2017.plot: Twenty years after betraying his friends and fleeing with their money, Mark Renton returns to Edinburgh. He reconnects with Spud, Sick Boy and a vengeful, prison-escaped Begbie, confronting what has become of their lives.

r-drugstore-cowboy-1989.plot: In early-1970s Oregon, a charismatic addict leads a small crew that robs pharmacies to feed their habits. After a run of bad luck and paranoia, he tries to go straight.

r-something-s-gotta-give-2003.plot: A sixty-something music mogul who only dates younger women suffers a heart attack at the Hamptons beach house of his girlfriend's mother, a successful playwright. Forced to recover under her roof, he finds himself falling for a woman his own age, as does his young doctor.

setting.place: The Hamptons; New York City; Paris

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Diane Keaton

r-where-is-the-friend-s-house-1987.plot: An Iranian schoolboy realizes he has taken his classmate's notebook by mistake. Knowing his friend will be punished without it, he sets off through neighboring villages at dusk to find the boy's home.

r-the-color-of-paradise-1999.plot: A blind boy who loves the natural world returns from his school in Tehran to his family's village for the summer. His widowed father, ashamed of him and hoping to remarry, wants to send him away.

r-the-white-balloon-1995.plot: In Tehran on the eve of the Persian New Year, a young girl sets out with her family's money to buy a goldfish. When she loses the banknote, a string of encounters with strangers follows as she tries to retrieve it.

r-the-perks-of-being-a-wallflower-2012.plot: Charlie, a shy and troubled freshman, starts high school isolated and grieving. Two charismatic seniors, half-siblings Sam and Patrick, take him under their wing, opening a world of music, parties and friendship while his past resurfaces.
r-the-perks-of-being-a-wallflower-2012.source: The Perks of Being a Wallflower

r-gifted-2017.plot: A single man raising his mathematically gifted young niece in Florida wants her to have a normal childhood. His formidable mother has other plans for the girl, sparking a custody battle.

r-devil-in-a-blue-dress-1995.plot: A laid-off Black veteran in postwar Los Angeles takes cash to find a missing white woman who frequents jazz clubs. The job drags him into murder and a political scandal.

r-the-nice-guys-2016.plot: In 1977 Los Angeles, a hired enforcer and a hapless private eye reluctantly team up to find a missing girl. Their search, connected to the death of an adult-film star, uncovers a conspiracy reaching surprising heights.

r-jakob-the-liar-1999.plot: In a Nazi-occupied Polish ghetto, a Jewish shopkeeper overhears radio news of Soviet advances. To lift his neighbors' spirits he claims to own a hidden radio, and soon must keep inventing hopeful reports, at growing risk.

r-train-of-life-1998.plot: In 1941, the village fool of a Jewish shtetl warns that the Nazis are coming. The villagers decide to stage their own deportation, buying a train and disguising some of themselves as German soldiers to escape toward Palestine.

r-nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind-198.plot: A thousand years after a global catastrophe, a toxic jungle full of giant insects spreads across the land. Nausicaä, princess of a small valley, seeks harmony with nature as warring kingdoms threaten to unleash a terrible weapon.
r-nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind-198.source: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

r-wolfwalkers-2020.plot: In 1650 Ireland, a young English girl comes with her father, a hunter sent to wipe out the last wolf pack. She befriends a wild girl from a tribe who become wolves while they sleep, and must choose sides.

r-akira-1988.plot: In 2019 Neo-Tokyo, rebuilt after a catastrophic explosion, a biker gang member gains terrifying psychic powers after a secret military experiment. His childhood friend tries to stop him as his power spirals out of control.

r-brassed-off-1996.plot: In a Yorkshire mining town facing pit closure, the colliery's brass band fights on toward a national competition. Its devoted conductor sees the music as all that holds the community together.

r-calendar-girls-2003.plot: After a friend's husband dies of leukemia, a group of middle-aged women from a Yorkshire village club decide to raise money by posing nude for a charity calendar. Their tasteful stunt becomes an international sensation, testing friendships and family life.

r-this-is-england-2006.plot: In 1983, a bullied twelve-year-old who lost his father in the Falklands War is taken in by a friendly gang of local skinheads. When a volatile older member returns from prison preaching nationalism, the group splits and the boy is drawn into racism and violence.

r-romper-stomper-1992.plot: A gang of violent neo-Nazi skinheads in Melbourne clashes with the Vietnamese community. When a troubled young woman joins them, tensions within the gang rise as their world begins to collapse.

r-the-believer-2001.plot: A brilliant young Jewish man from New York becomes a violent neo-Nazi skinhead. As he rises in a fascist group, he remains entangled with the faith and traditions he claims to despise.

r-elizabeth-the-golden-age-2007.plot: Decades into her reign, Queen Elizabeth I faces plots to put Mary, Queen of Scots on the throne and the threat of Spain's mighty Armada. At the same time, she is drawn to the adventurer Walter Raleigh, a temptation she must weigh against her crown.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Cate Blanchett

r-mary-queen-of-scots-2018.plot: Widowed in France, Mary Stuart returns to Scotland to claim her throne and a rival claim to England's. Her cousin Elizabeth I watches warily as court intrigue, rebellion and betrayal pull both queens toward confrontation.
r-mary-queen-of-scots-2018.source: Queen of Scots: The True Life of Mary Stuart

r-layer-cake-2004.plot: A careful, nameless London cocaine dealer plans to retire with his fortune. Before he can, his boss assigns him two final jobs: find a crime lord's missing daughter and sell a huge stash of stolen ecstasy, dragging him into a dangerous web of double-crosses.

r-the-gentlemen-2019.plot: An American expat who built a cannabis empire in England tries to sell his business and retire. Word of the sale triggers a scramble of schemes, bribery and blackmail among rivals eager to take it from him.

r-fury-2014.plot: In April 1945, a battle-hardened American tank commander leads his exhausted crew deep into Nazi Germany. A green young typist is assigned to the tank and must learn the brutal realities of war as the crew faces overwhelming odds.

r-black-hawk-down-2001.plot: In 1993, US Army Rangers and Delta Force soldiers attempt to capture lieutenants of a Somali warlord in Mogadishu. When two Black Hawk helicopters are shot down, the mission becomes a desperate, overnight battle for survival.
r-black-hawk-down-2001.source: Black Hawk Down: A Story of Modern War

r-flags-of-our-fathers-2006.plot: Three of the servicemen photographed raising the American flag on Iwo Jima are pulled from battle and sent on a war bond tour as heroes. Haunted by the fighting and by comrades they lost, they struggle with the gap between the image and the truth.

r-anonymous-2011.plot: Amid Elizabethan court intrigue and a struggle over the succession, the film imagines that Edward de Vere, Earl of Oxford, secretly wrote the plays attributed to William Shakespeare. Political scheming, a hidden royal past and theater collide in London.

r-inherent-vice-2014.plot: In 1970 Los Angeles, a perpetually stoned private eye is asked by his ex-girlfriend to help with a plot involving her wealthy lover. The case pulls him into a sprawling, hazy web of cops, cults, dentists, surfers and a shadowy organization.

r-a-hidden-life-2019.plot: Austrian farmer Franz Jägerstätter refuses to swear loyalty to Hitler or fight for the Nazis. Facing imprisonment and possible execution, he holds to his conscience while his wife and village bear the consequences.

r-stranger-than-fiction-2006.plot: A lonely, routine-bound IRS auditor suddenly hears a woman's voice narrating his life, and learns from it that he will soon die. With help from a literature professor, he searches for the author writing his story before she finishes it.

r-revolutionary-road-2008.plot: A young couple in 1950s suburban Connecticut feel smothered by conformity and their unfulfilling routine. The wife proposes moving the family to Paris to start over, but the plan exposes resentments that steadily tear the marriage apart.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Michael Shannon

r-little-children-2006.plot: In a quiet Massachusetts suburb, a restless stay-at-home mother begins an affair with a handsome stay-at-home father she meets at the playground. Meanwhile, the neighborhood is unsettled by the return of a convicted sex offender to his mother's home.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jackie Earle Haley
Actress in a Leading Role — Kate Winslet

r-american-psycho-2000.plot: A wealthy, image-obsessed Manhattan investment banker in the late 1980s hides a secret life as a serial killer. As his violent urges escalate, his grip on reality, and on the masks he wears, starts to slip.

r-the-machinist-2004.plot: A factory machinist who has not slept in a year has wasted away to a skeleton. After he causes a workplace accident, mysterious notes and a strange new co-worker no one else seems to know push him toward paranoia and a buried truth.

r-donnie-darko-2001.plot: In 1988 suburban Virginia, a troubled teenager survives a freak accident after a man in a rabbit costume lures him outside. The figure tells him the world will end in 28 days, and Donnie is drawn into visions, time travel and dark acts.

r-the-world-according-to-garp-1982.plot: The life story of T.S. Garp, son of a fiercely independent nurse turned feminist icon, as he grows up, becomes a writer, marries and raises children in a world full of absurd tragedy and comedy.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — John Lithgow
Actress in a Supporting Role — Glenn Close

r-the-mist-2007.plot: After a storm, a thick fog rolls into a small Maine town, and something deadly lurks inside it. Trapped in a supermarket, a father and his young son watch the frightened shoppers split into factions as a fanatical woman gains followers.

r-dead-man-walking-1995.plot: A Louisiana nun becomes the spiritual adviser to a convicted murderer on death row. As his execution approaches, she seeks to help him face the truth while also confronting the grief of the victims' families.

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Susan Sarandon
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Sean Penn

r-dark-waters-2019.plot: A corporate defense lawyer agrees to look into a West Virginia farmer's claim that a chemical plant is killing his cattle. His investigation exposes decades of toxic pollution by DuPont and becomes a years-long legal crusade.
r-dark-waters-2019.source: The Lawyer Who Became DuPont's Worst Nightmare

r-thank-you-for-smoking-2005.plot: A slick, quick-talking lobbyist for Big Tobacco spins his way through talk shows and Senate hearings defending cigarettes. He tries to remain a role model for his young son while facing a crusading senator and a journalist who threatens his reputation.

r-castle-in-the-sky-1986.plot: A mining-town boy rescues a girl who floats down from the sky wearing a mysterious crystal. Pursued by sky pirates and government agents, they search for Laputa, a legendary flying city.

setting.place: Fictional European mining town and skies

r-big-hero-6-2014.plot: In the futuristic city of San Fransokyo, a teenage robotics prodigy bonds with the gentle inflatable healthcare robot built by his brother. After a tragedy, he turns the robot and a group of science-minded friends into a high-tech team to uncover a masked villain.
writers: Steven T. Seagle and Duncan Rouleau (comic)

r-lilo-stitch-2002.plot: A lonely Hawaiian girl, raised by her struggling older sister, adopts an odd 'dog' that is really an escaped alien experiment built for destruction. While galactic agents try to recapture him, the creature learns the meaning of family.

r-dark-city-1998.plot: A man wakes in a hotel bathtub with no memory, wanted for murders he cannot recall. In a city where the sun never rises, he discovers that pale strangers rearrange the streets and people's memories every night.

r-the-others-2001.plot: In 1945, a devout mother waits for her husband to return from the war in an isolated mansion on Jersey, with two children who are deathly sensitive to light. After new servants arrive, strange events convince her that the house is haunted.

r-unbreakable-2000.plot: A Philadelphia security guard is the only survivor of a horrific train crash, without a scratch. A comic-book art dealer with extremely fragile bones approaches him with a strange theory about why he walked away unharmed.

r-the-orphanage-2007.plot: A woman returns with her husband and adopted son to the seaside orphanage where she grew up, planning to reopen it for disabled children. When her son begins talking to invisible friends and then vanishes, she becomes convinced the house holds the answer.

r-like-water-for-chocolate-1992.plot: Forbidden by family tradition to marry, the youngest daughter of a Mexican ranching family pours her emotions into her cooking, which has magical effects on everyone who eats it, while the man she loves marries her sister.

setting.place: A ranch near the Mexico-US border

r-babette-s-feast-1987.plot: Two pious sisters in a remote Danish village take in a French refugee as their cook. Years later, she wins a lottery and asks to prepare a lavish French dinner for the austere congregation.

r-hero-2002.plot: In ancient China, a nameless warrior is granted an audience with the King of Qin after claiming to have killed three legendary assassins. As he tells his story, the king suspects a different version of events, told in vivid colors.

r-house-of-flying-daggers-2004.plot: In the declining Tang dynasty, two police captains use a blind dancer suspected of belonging to a rebel group to track down its leader. One of them escorts her on a journey through forests and fields, where love complicates every loyalty.

r-the-grandmaster-2013.plot: Kung fu master Ip Man rises to prominence in 1930s Foshan, where he forms a deep bond with the daughter of a northern grandmaster. War and the Japanese occupation scatter their lives, and both end up in Hong Kong carrying their traditions forward.

r-troy-2004.plot: When Trojan prince Paris takes Helen from her Spartan husband, the Greek kingdoms unite to wage war on Troy. The great warrior Achilles joins the siege for glory, and his clash with the Trojan hero Hector shapes the conflict's fate.

r-primer-2004.plot: Two engineers tinkering with a garage invention realize they have accidentally built a device that allows time travel. As they exploit it for profit, overlapping loops and duplicated selves erode their trust in each other.

r-pi-1998.plot: A reclusive mathematician in New York, plagued by headaches, believes a hidden numerical pattern underlies the stock market and all of nature. His obsession attracts Wall Street sharks and a group of Kabbalists, and pushes him toward breakdown.

r-christiane-f-1981.plot: A 13-year-old girl in a bleak West Berlin housing estate drifts into the club scene, then into heroin addiction and prostitution around the Zoo train station. A stark portrait of teenage drug culture drawn from a real girl's account.

r-sicario-2015.plot: An idealistic FBI agent is recruited to a shadowy government task force fighting a Mexican drug cartel along the U.S.-Mexico border. Working with a mysterious consultant, she finds the operation's methods and goals far murkier than she was told.

r-syriana-2005.plot: Interlocking stories reveal the global oil industry's reach: a veteran CIA operative in the Middle East, an energy analyst advising a reformist Gulf prince, a Washington lawyer vetting a corporate merger, and a young migrant worker drawn toward militancy.

setting.place: Persian Gulf; Washington, D.C.; Texas; Lebanon; Iran

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — George Clooney

r-maria-full-of-grace-2004.plot: A pregnant seventeen-year-old from rural Colombia, desperate to escape her dead-end job, agrees to smuggle heroin into the United States by swallowing pellets. The perilous trip to New York tests her courage and her loyalty to the other young women on the flight.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Catalina Sandino Moreno

r-the-man-who-knew-infinity-2015.plot: Srinivasa Ramanujan, a self-taught mathematical genius from Madras, travels to Cambridge to work with professor G.H. Hardy. Facing racism, war and illness, he fights to prove the validity of his extraordinary theories.
r-the-man-who-knew-infinity-2015.source: The Man Who Knew Infinity (Robert Kanigel)

r-proof-2005.plot: After the death of her father, a brilliant mathematician who descended into mental illness, his daughter fears she has inherited both his gift and his instability. When a groundbreaking proof is found among his notebooks, its authorship is called into question.

r-delicatessen-1991.plot: In a starving post-apocalyptic France, a butcher who runs an apartment building lures handymen in to supply his shop with meat. A gentle former clown takes the job and falls for the butcher's shy daughter.

r-a-very-long-engagement-2004.plot: After World War I, a young Breton woman is told her fiancé died after being sentenced, with four other soldiers, to be left in no man's land. Refusing to believe it, she pieces together clues from survivors to learn what really happened.

r-moonrise-kingdom-2012.plot: On a New England island in 1965, two twelve-year-olds in love, an orphaned Khaki Scout and a troubled girl, run away together into the wilderness. As a storm approaches, the local sheriff, her parents and a scout troop mount a search.

r-blue-ruin-2013.plot: A quiet drifter living out of his car learns that the man who killed his parents is being released from prison. He returns to his Virginia hometown to take revenge, but his clumsy vendetta sets off a violent feud with a dangerous family.

r-monsters-university-2013.plot: Long before they were a scaring team, Mike Wazowski and James P. Sullivan were rivals at Monsters University. Expelled from the elite scaring program, they must team up with a band of misfits to win the Scare Games and earn their way back.

r-hotel-transylvania-2012.plot: Dracula runs a luxury resort where monsters can escape from humans, and he hosts a party for his daughter's 118th birthday. When a backpacking human stumbles in and catches her eye, the overprotective father scrambles to keep him hidden.

r-the-great-gatsby-2013.plot: Aspiring writer Nick Carraway moves to Long Island in 1922, next door to the mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby and his lavish parties. Nick is drawn into Gatsby's obsessive quest to win back Nick's cousin Daisy, now married to a wealthy brute.

r-coraline-2009.plot: Bored and neglected after moving to an old house, a girl finds a small hidden door leading to a parallel world. There, an Other Mother with button eyes offers everything she wants, but the price of staying turns out to be terrifying.

r-harry-potter-and-the-sorcerer-s-stone-.plot: An orphaned boy raised by cruel relatives learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard. At Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry he makes close friends and uncovers a plot involving a powerful magical stone.
r-harry-potter-and-the-sorcerer-s-stone-.source: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

r-stardust-2007.plot: To win the heart of a village beauty, a young man crosses the wall separating his English town from a magical kingdom to retrieve a fallen star. The star turns out to be a woman, and he must protect her from witches and murderous princes who want her too.

setting.place: Village of Wall, England; magical kingdom of Stormhold

r-matchstick-men-2003.plot: An obsessive-compulsive con artist in Los Angeles works small scams with his ambitious protégé. When he unexpectedly meets the teenage daughter he never knew, his orderly life is upended just as the pair plan a major score.

r-nine-2009.plot: A celebrated Italian film director faces a creative crisis days before shooting his next picture, with no script in hand. As pressure mounts, he seeks refuge with the women in his life: his wife, mistress, muse, confidante and mother.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Penélope Cruz

r-roxie-hart-1942.plot: In 1920s Chicago, a fame-hungry dancer takes the blame for a killing she didn't commit, betting that a sensational trial will make her a star. With a showboating lawyer and a hungry press, the courtroom turns into a circus.

r-dreamgirls-2006.plot: In 1960s Detroit, a trio of young Black singers is taken on by an ambitious car salesman turned manager who pushes them into pop stardom. As the group climbs the charts, his decision to replace the lead singer fractures friendships and loyalties.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Jennifer Hudson
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Eddie Murphy

r-elite-squad-2007.plot: In 1997 Rio de Janeiro, the burned-out captain of the BOPE special police unit seeks a successor before the Pope's visit, which demands clearing a violent favela. Two idealistic rookies confront police corruption, the drug trade and the unit's brutal methods.

r-amores-perros-2000.plot: A violent car crash in Mexico City links three stories: a young man who enters his dog in fights to win his brother's wife, a model whose life collapses after the accident, and a former guerrilla turned hitman living with stray dogs.

r-road-to-perdition-2002.plot: In Depression-era Illinois, a loyal enforcer for an Irish mob boss sees his family destroyed after his son witnesses a killing. Father and son go on the run across the Midwest, seeking revenge while the father hopes to keep the boy from following his path.

setting.place: Rock Island, Illinois; Chicago; rural Midwest

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Paul Newman

r-mrs-dalloway-1997.plot: Over one June day in post-war London, a society hostess prepares for an evening party while memories of her youth and an old suitor resurface. In parallel, a shell-shocked veteran drifts through the city, haunted by the war.

r-excalibur-1981.plot: A visually lush retelling of Arthurian legend, from Uther's lust and Arthur drawing the sword from the stone to the rise of Camelot, Lancelot and Guinevere's betrayal, Merlin's fall, and the quest for the Grail.

r-harry-potter-and-the-prisoner-of-azkab.plot: In his third year at Hogwarts, Harry learns that a notorious prisoner believed to have betrayed his parents has escaped from the wizard prison Azkaban. With soul-draining guards patrolling the school, Harry, Ron and Hermione uncover surprising truths about his family's past.
r-harry-potter-and-the-prisoner-of-azkab.source: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

r-finding-dory-2016.plot: Forgetful blue tang Dory suddenly remembers fragments of her childhood and the parents she lost. With Marlin and Nemo, she sets out across the ocean to a California marine life institute to find them.

r-moana-2016.plot: When a blight threatens her island, Moana, the daughter of a Polynesian chief, sets sail across the ocean. She recruits the boastful demigod Maui to return a stolen relic and restore the heart of the sea goddess.

r-luca-2021.plot: A young sea monster who can look human on dry land spends a summer in a seaside Italian town with his new best friend. They hide their secret while chasing a dream of owning a Vespa.

r-kill-bill-vol-2-2004.plot: The Bride continues her quest for vengeance, tracking down the remaining members of the assassination squad that attacked her on her wedding day. Her journey leads finally to Bill himself, as the story behind the massacre is revealed.

r-lady-snowblood-1973.plot: Born in prison to a mother bent on revenge, a young woman is trained from childhood as a deadly swordswoman. In Meiji-era Japan she hunts down the criminals who murdered her family and brutalized her mother, one by one.

r-the-raid-2011.plot: A rookie member of an elite Jakarta police squad joins a raid on a run-down tower block controlled by a ruthless crime lord. When the operation goes wrong, the team is trapped and must fight floor by floor through waves of armed tenants.

r-somewhere-2010.plot: A successful Hollywood actor drifts through an aimless existence of parties and empty hotel days at the Chateau Marmont. When his 11-year-old daughter comes to stay unexpectedly, their time together makes him reconsider his life.

r-broken-flowers-2005.plot: A wealthy, emotionally detached bachelor receives an anonymous pink letter claiming he has a nineteen-year-old son. Prodded by his amateur-sleuth neighbor, he reluctantly road-trips to visit four former girlfriends in search of the mother.

r-captain-horatio-hornblower-1951.plot: During the Napoleonic Wars, a cool-headed Royal Navy captain carries out a secret mission off Central America, then must ferry a stranded English noblewoman home. Duty and growing feelings collide as he faces French warships and a daring escape from captivity.
r-captain-horatio-hornblower-1951.source: The Happy Return, A Ship of the Line, Flying Colours

setting.place: Pacific coast of Central America; Spain; France

r-mother-2009.plot: When her intellectually disabled son is arrested for the murder of a schoolgirl in their small town, a devoted widow refuses to believe he is guilty. Ignored by police and lawyers, she launches her own relentless investigation to find the real killer.

r-the-chaser-2008.plot: A disgraced ex-cop turned pimp suspects someone is selling off his missing women. When he tracks down the man responsible, the police arrest the suspect but cannot hold him without evidence, leaving the pimp racing the clock to find a captive still alive.

r-gone-baby-gone-2007.plot: Two Boston private investigators are hired to help find a four-year-old girl who vanished from her neglectful mother's home in a working-class neighborhood. Their search through the city's underworld leads to a moral dilemma with no easy answer.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Amy Ryan

r-changeling-2008.plot: When a single mother's young son disappears, the Los Angeles police return a boy she insists is not hers. Refusing to accept him, she challenges a corrupt department that tries to silence her, while a separate investigation uncovers horrifying crimes.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Angelina Jolie

r-sympathy-for-mr-vengeance-2002.plot: A deaf factory worker desperate to pay for his sister's kidney transplant is cheated by organ traffickers and turns to kidnapping a wealthy man's daughter. When the plan goes tragically wrong, the grieving father sets out on a relentless quest for revenge.

r-lady-vengeance-2005.plot: Released after thirteen years in prison for the kidnapping and murder of a young boy, a woman who became a model inmate sets her long-prepared plan in motion. With help from former cellmates, she seeks revenge on the man truly responsible.

r-i-saw-the-devil-2010.plot: After his fiancée is brutally murdered by a serial killer, a South Korean secret agent tracks the man down. Instead of killing him, he begins a sadistic cycle of capturing, torturing and releasing him, blurring the line between hunter and monster.

r-pirates-of-the-caribbean-dead-man-s-ch.plot: Captain Jack Sparrow owes his soul to the fearsome Davy Jones and must find the chest that holds Jones's heart. Meanwhile, Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann, arrested on their wedding day, are pulled into the hunt across the Caribbean.
r-pirates-of-the-caribbean-dead-man-s-ch.source: Pirates of the Caribbean (Disney theme park ride)

r-secretariat-2010.plot: A Denver housewife takes over her ailing father's Virginia horse farm despite having no experience in racing. Teaming with an eccentric trainer, she bets everything on a young colt that goes on to chase the Triple Crown.
r-secretariat-2010.source: Secretariat: The Making of a Champion

r-1900-1976.plot: Two boys born on the same day in 1901 on an Emilian estate, one the landowner's heir and the other a peasant's grandson, grow up as friends. Across decades of strikes, the rise of Fascism and liberation, class conflict divides them.

r-we-all-loved-each-other-so-much-1974.plot: Three friends who fought together in the Italian resistance drift apart after the war: one becomes a hospital porter, one a provincial intellectual, one a rich lawyer. Over three decades they love the same woman and measure their hopes against how Italy turned out.

r-the-last-samurai-2003.plot: A disillusioned American Civil War veteran is hired to train Japan's new imperial army against rebel samurai. Captured by the rebels, he comes to admire their discipline and way of life, and must choose a side as modernization threatens their existence.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Ken Watanabe

r-valkyrie-2008.plot: A German colonel wounded in North Africa joins a circle of officers plotting to kill Hitler. He devises a plan to assassinate the Führer with a bomb and then use an emergency reserve-army order to seize control of Berlin.

r-the-wannsee-conference-2022.plot: In January 1942, senior Nazi officials gather at a villa near Berlin for a meeting chaired by Reinhard Heydrich. Over a single morning they coordinate the bureaucratic details of the Holocaust.

r-sophie-scholl-the-final-days-2005.plot: In 1943 Munich, student Sophie Scholl and her brother are arrested for distributing anti-Nazi leaflets for the White Rose resistance group. Over several days of interrogation and a show trial, she defends her convictions with steady courage.

r-being-john-malkovich-1999.plot: A struggling puppeteer takes a filing job on a strange half-floor of a Manhattan office building and finds a portal into the mind of actor John Malkovich. He, his wife and a coworker turn the discovery into a business, with bizarre results.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Catherine Keener

r-adaptation-2002.plot: A neurotic screenwriter struggles to turn a meditative nonfiction book about orchid hunters into a film, while his carefree twin brother breezes through a formulaic thriller script. The project spirals into a story about the writer himself.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Chris Cooper
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Nicolas Cage
Actress in a Supporting Role — Meryl Streep

r-the-science-of-sleep-2006.plot: A shy, imaginative young man returns to Paris for a dull job at a calendar company and moves into his childhood home. He falls for his artistic neighbor, but his vivid dreams increasingly blur with waking life, complicating his attempts to win her.

r-miss-potter-2006.plot: In Edwardian London, unmarried Beatrix Potter defies her parents' expectations to publish her illustrated tales of Peter Rabbit. Her success and a growing romance with her publisher open a new chapter, leading her eventually to the Lake District.

r-beasts-of-no-nation-2015.plot: When civil war tears through his West African village and kills his family, a young boy is captured by rebel fighters. Their charismatic, brutal commandant turns him into a child soldier, and he struggles to hold onto his humanity.

r-blood-diamond-2006.plot: During Sierra Leone's civil war, a fisherman forced to work in diamond fields hides a huge pink stone. A Rhodesian smuggler and an idealistic American journalist team up with him, each with different motives, as he searches for his kidnapped son.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Leonardo DiCaprio
Actor in a Supporting Role — Djimon Hounsou

r-shooting-dogs-2005.plot: As the 1994 Rwandan genocide begins, an English priest and a young idealistic teacher shelter thousands of Tutsi refugees at a Kigali school guarded by UN peacekeepers. When the peacekeepers are ordered to withdraw, both men must decide whether to stay.

r-mary-and-the-witch-s-flower-2017.plot: Bored while staying with her great-aunt in the countryside, a young girl finds a rare flower that briefly grants her magic powers. A broomstick carries her to a school of witchcraft above the clouds, where she uncovers dangerous secrets.

r-girlfight-2000.plot: An angry Brooklyn high-school student who keeps getting into fights finds an outlet in her brother's boxing gym. Training against her father's wishes, she enters amateur competition, where she may have to face the young man she loves.

r-get-on-up-2014.plot: A non-linear portrait of James Brown, tracing his rise from a deprived childhood in the American South to becoming the Godfather of Soul. The film covers his explosive performances, his creative drive and his difficult relationships with bandmates and family.

setting.place: Georgia and touring across the US and abroad

r-bottle-shock-2008.plot: A British wine merchant in Paris organizes a blind tasting pitting French wines against unknown Californian ones. In Napa Valley, a struggling vintner and his slacker son try to keep their winery afloat, unaware their chardonnay is about to make history.

r-the-trip-2010.plot: Steve Coogan, playing a version of himself, is hired to review restaurants across northern England and brings along fellow comedian Rob Brydon. Over fine meals and scenic drives, the two trade celebrity impressions, rivalries and quiet reflections on age and ambition.

setting.place: Lake District and Yorkshire Dales, England

r-greenberg-2010.plot: Fresh out of a psychiatric stay, a prickly fortysomething former musician house-sits for his successful brother in Los Angeles while deliberately doing nothing. He stumbles into an awkward relationship with his brother's young personal assistant and reconnects with old bandmates.

r-tucker-the-man-and-his-dream-1988.plot: After WWII, visionary inventor Preston Tucker sets out to build an innovative, safety-focused car. His dream draws public excitement but also the hostility of Detroit's big automakers and their political allies.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Martin Landau

r-steve-jobs-2015.plot: Structured around the backstage moments before three landmark product launches, the film portrays Steve Jobs clashing with colleagues and confronting his strained relationship with the daughter he initially denied.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Michael Fassbender
Actress in a Supporting Role — Kate Winslet

r-incredibles-2-2018.plot: With superheroes still outlawed, Elastigirl is recruited for a publicity campaign to win back public support, leaving Bob at home with the kids and baby Jack-Jack's emerging powers. Meanwhile a mysterious villain hijacks screens across the city.

r-megamind-2010.plot: A brilliant but bumbling blue supervillain finally defeats his heroic nemesis and takes over Metro City, only to find life without a rival pointless. When he creates a new hero to fight, his creation turns out far worse than he planned.

r-the-batman-2022.plot: In his second year as Batman, Bruce Wayne investigates a sadistic serial killer, the Riddler, who targets Gotham's elite and leaves cryptic clues. The trail exposes corruption tied to the city's mob and his own family.

r-batman-1989.plot: As Batman begins striking fear into Gotham's criminals, a mobster disfigured in a chemical accident reemerges as the Joker and terrorizes the city. A photojournalist gets caught between them.

r-casino-royale-2006.plot: Newly promoted to 00 status, James Bond is sent to bankrupt a financier of terrorists in a high-stakes poker game at a Montenegro casino. Teamed with a sharp Treasury agent, he finds his first big mission testing both his skills and his heart.

r-carol-2015.plot: In 1950s New York, a young aspiring photographer working in a department store becomes captivated by an elegant older woman going through a bitter divorce. Their growing romance clashes with the conventions of the era and a custody battle.

setting.place: New York City; American Midwest road trip

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Cate Blanchett
Actress in a Supporting Role — Rooney Mara

r-god-s-own-country-2017.plot: A young Yorkshire sheep farmer numbs his frustration and isolation with binge-drinking and casual encounters. When a Romanian migrant worker arrives to help during lambing season, an intense relationship develops that may change his life.

r-the-bridges-of-madison-county-1995.plot: Sorting their late mother's things, two adult siblings discover she had a four-day affair with a National Geographic photographer while her family was away. Her journals reveal a passion that shaped the rest of her life.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Meryl Streep
